verses.textZh: 作使徒的保罗 ，
verses.textZhCnvs: 作使徒的保罗 ，
verses.textZhCuv: 作使徒的保罗（不是由于人，也不是藉着人，乃是藉着耶稣基督，与叫他从死里复活的父神）
verses.textEnNiv: Paul, an apostle—sent not from men nor by a man, but by Jesus Christ and God the Father, who raised him from the dead—
verses.textEnEsv: Paul, an apostle— not from men nor through man, but through Jesus Christ and God the Father, who raised him from the dead—
verses.textEnNkjv: Paul, an apostle (not from men nor through man, but through Jesus Christ and God the Father who raised Him from the dead),
verses.textEnNlt: This letter is from Paul, an apostle. I was not appointed by any group of people or any human authority, but by Jesus Christ himself and by God the Father, who raised Jesus from the dead.
verses.textEnNasb: Paul, an apostle (not sent from men nor through human agency, but through Jesus Christ and God the Father, who raised Him from the dead),
verses.textEn: Paul, an apostle—sent not from men nor by a man, but by Jesus Christ and God the Father, who raised him from the dead—

verses.textZh: 和所有与我在一起的弟兄，写信给加拉太的众教会。
verses.textZhCnvs: 和所有与我在一起的弟兄，写信给加拉太的众教会。
verses.textZhCuv: 和一切与我同在的众弟兄，写信给加拉太的各教会。
verses.textEnNiv: and all the brothers and sisters with me, To the churches in Galatia:
verses.textEnEsv: and all the brothers who are with me, To the churches of Galatia:
verses.textEnNkjv: and all the brethren who are with me, To the churches of Galatia:
verses.textEnNlt: All the brothers and sisters here join me in sending this letter to the churches of Galatia.
verses.textEnNasb: and all the brothers who are with me, To the churches of Galatia:
verses.textEn: and all the brothers and sisters with me, To the churches in Galatia:

verses.textZh: 愿恩惠平安从我们的父神和主耶稣基督临到你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿恩惠平安从我们的父神和主耶稣基督临到你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿恩惠、平安从父神与我们的主耶稣基督归与你们！
verses.textEnNiv: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.textEnEsv: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.textEnNkjv: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.textEnNlt: May God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ give you grace and peace.
verses.textEnNasb: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.textEn: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ,

verses.textZh: 基督照着我们父神的旨意，曾经为我们的罪舍己，为的是要救我们脱离现在这邪恶的世代。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基督照着我们父神的旨意，曾经为我们的罪舍己，为的是要救我们脱离现在这邪恶的世代。
verses.textZhCuv: 基督照我们父神的旨意，为我们的罪舍己，要救我们脱离这罪恶的世代。
verses.textEnNiv: who gave himself for our sins to rescue us from the present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father,
verses.textEnEsv: who gave himself for our sins to deliver us from the present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father,
verses.textEnNkjv: who gave Himself for our sins, that He might deliver us from this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father,
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus gave his life for our sins, just as God our Father planned, in order to rescue us from this evil world in which we live.
verses.textEnNasb: who gave Himself for our sins so that He might rescue us from this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father,
verses.textEn: who gave himself for our sins to rescue us from the present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father,

verses.textZh: 愿荣耀归给他，直到永永远远。阿们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿荣耀归给他，直到永永远远。阿们。
verses.textZhCuv: 但愿荣耀归于神，直到永永远远。阿们！
verses.textEnNiv: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.textEnEsv: to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
verses.textEnNkjv: to whom be glory forever and ever. Amen.
verses.textEnNlt: All glory to God forever and ever! Amen.
verses.textEnNasb: to whom be the glory forevermore. Amen.
verses.textEn: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

verses.textZh: 我很惊奇，你们这么快就离开了借着基督的恩呼召你们的那一位，去归向别的福音。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我很惊奇，你们这么快就离开了借着基督的恩呼召你们的那一位，去归向别的福音。
verses.textZhCuv: 我希奇你们这么快离开那藉着基督之恩召你们的，去从别的福音。
verses.textEnNiv: I am astonished that you are so quickly deserting the one who called you to live in the grace of Christ and are turning to a different gospel—
verses.textEnEsv: I am astonished that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ and are turning to a different gospel—
verses.textEnNkjv: I marvel that you are turning away so soon from Him who called you in the grace of Christ, to a different gospel,
verses.textEnNlt: I am shocked that you are turning away so soon from God, who called you to himself through the loving mercy of Christ. You are following a different way that pretends to be the Good News
verses.textEnNasb: I am amazed that you are so quickly deserting Him who called you by the grace of Christ, for a different gospel,
verses.textEn: I am astonished that you are so quickly deserting the one who called you to live in the grace of Christ and are turning to a different gospel—

verses.textZh: 其实那并不是另一个福音，只是有些搅扰你们的人，想把基督的福音改变。
verses.textZhCnvs: 其实那并不是另一个福音，只是有些搅扰你们的人，想把基督的福音改变。
verses.textZhCuv: 那并不是福音，不过有些人搅扰你们，要把基督的福音更改了。
verses.textEnNiv: which is really no gospel at all. Evidently some people are throwing you into confusion and are trying to pervert the gospel of Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: not that there is another one, but there are some who trouble you and want to distort the gospel of Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: which is not another; but there are some who trouble you and want to pervert the gospel of Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: but is not the Good News at all. You are being fooled by those who deliberately twist the truth concerning Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: which is not just another account; but there are some who are disturbing you and want to distort the gospel of Christ.
verses.textEn: which is really no gospel at all. Evidently some people are throwing you into confusion and are trying to pervert the gospel of Christ.

verses.textZh: 但无论是我们，或是从天上来的使者，如果传给你们的和我们以前传给你们的福音不同，他就该受咒诅。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但无论是我们，或是从天上来的使者，如果传给你们的和我们以前传给你们的福音不同，他就该受咒诅。
verses.textZhCuv: 但无论是我们，是天上来的使者，若传福音给你们，与我们所传给你们的不同，他就应当被咒诅。
verses.textEnNiv: But even if we or an angel from heaven should preach a gospel other than the one we preached to you, let them be under God’s curse!
verses.textEnEsv: But even if we or an angel from heaven should preach to you a gospel contrary to the one we preached to you, let him be accursed.
verses.textEnNkjv: But even if we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel to you than what we have preached to you, let him be accursed.
verses.textEnNlt: Let God’s curse fall on anyone, including us or even an angel from heaven, who preaches a different kind of Good News than the one we preached to you.
verses.textEnNasb: But even if we, or an angel from heaven, should preach to you a gospel contrary to what we have preached to you, he is to be accursed!
verses.textEn: But even if we or an angel from heaven should preach a gospel other than the one we preached to you, let them be under God’s curse!

verses.textZh: 我们已经说过，现在我要再说，如果有人传给你们的和你们以前所领受的福音不同，他就该受咒诅。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们已经说过，现在我要再说，如果有人传给你们的和你们以前所领受的福音不同，他就该受咒诅。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们已经说了，现在又说，若有人传福音给你们，与你们所领受的不同，他就应当被咒诅。
verses.textEnNiv: As we have already said, so now I say again: If anybody is preaching to you a gospel other than what you accepted, let them be under God’s curse!
verses.textEnEsv: As we have said before, so now I say again: If anyone is preaching to you a gospel contrary to the one you received, let him be accursed.
verses.textEnNkjv: As we have said before, so now I say again, if anyone preaches any other gospel to you than what you have received, let him be accursed.
verses.textEnNlt: I say again what we have said before: If anyone preaches any other Good News than the one you welcomed, let that person be cursed.
verses.textEnNasb: As we have said before, even now I say again: if anyone is preaching to you a gospel contrary to what you received, he is to be accursed!
verses.textEn: As we have already said, so now I say again: If anybody is preaching to you a gospel other than what you accepted, let them be under God’s curse!

verses.textZh: 我现在是要得人的欢心，还是要得神的欢心呢？难道我想讨人欢喜吗？如果我仍然要讨人欢喜，就不是基督的仆人了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我现在是要得人的欢心，还是要得神的欢心呢？难道我想讨人欢喜吗？如果我仍然要讨人欢喜，就不是基督的仆人了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我现在是要得人的心呢？还是要得神的心呢？我岂是讨人的喜欢吗？若仍旧讨人的喜欢，我就不是基督的仆人了。
verses.textEnNiv: Am I now trying to win the approval of human beings, or of God? Or am I trying to please people? If I were still trying to please people, I would not be a servant of Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: For am I now seeking the approval of man, or of God? Or am I trying to please man? If I were still trying to please man, I would not be a servant of Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: For do I now persuade men, or God? Or do I seek to please men? For if I still pleased men, I would not be a bondservant of Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: Obviously, I’m not trying to win the approval of people, but of God. If pleasing people were my goal, I would not be Christ’s servant.
verses.textEnNasb: For am I now seeking the favor of people, or of God? Or am I striving to please people? If I were still trying to please people, I would not be a bond-servant of Christ.
verses.textEn: Am I now trying to win the approval of human beings, or of God? Or am I trying to please people? If I were still trying to please people, I would not be a servant of Christ.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，我要你们知道，我所传的福音，并不是照着人的意思，
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，我要你们知道，我所传的福音，并不是照着人的意思，
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，我告诉你们，我素来所传的福音不是出于人的意思。
verses.textEnNiv: I want you to know, brothers and sisters, that the gospel I preached is not of human origin.
verses.textEnEsv: For I would have you know, brothers, that the gospel that was preached by me is not man’s gospel.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I make known to you, brethren, that the gospel which was preached by me is not according to man.
verses.textEnNlt: Dear brothers and sisters, I want you to understand that the gospel message I preach is not based on mere human reasoning.
verses.textEnNasb: For I would have you know, brothers and sisters, that the gospel which was preached by me is not of human invention.
verses.textEn: I want you to know, brothers and sisters, that the gospel I preached is not of human origin.

verses.textZh: 因为这福音我不是从人领受的，也不是人教导我的，而是借着耶稣基督的启示来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为这福音我不是从人领受的，也不是人教导我的，而是借着耶稣基督的启示来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我不是从人领受的，也不是人教导我的，乃是从耶稣基督启示来的。
verses.textEnNiv: I did not receive it from any man, nor was I taught it; rather, I received it by revelation from Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: For I did not receive it from any man, nor was I taught it, but I received it through a revelation of Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I neither received it from man, nor was I taught it, but itcame through the revelation of Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: I received my message from no human source, and no one taught me. Instead, I received it by direct revelation from Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: For I neither received it from man, nor was I taught it, but I received it through a revelation of Jesus Christ.
verses.textEn: I did not receive it from any man, nor was I taught it; rather, I received it by revelation from Jesus Christ.

verses.textZh: 你们听过我从前在犹太教中所行的：怎样极力逼迫残害神的教会，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们听过我从前在犹太教中所行的：怎样极力逼迫残害神的教会，
verses.textZhCuv: 你们听见我从前在犹太教中所行的事，怎样极力逼迫残害神的教会。
verses.textEnNiv: For you have heard of my previous way of life in Judaism, how intensely I persecuted the church of God and tried to destroy it.
verses.textEnEsv: For you have heard of my former life in Judaism, how I persecuted the church of God violently and tried to destroy it.
verses.textEnNkjv: For you have heard of my former conduct in Judaism, how I persecuted the church of God beyond measure and triedto destroy it.
verses.textEnNlt: You know what I was like when I followed the Jewish religion—how I violently persecuted God’s church. I did my best to destroy it.
verses.textEnNasb: For you have heard of my former way of life in Judaism, how I used to persecute the church of God beyond measure and tried to destroy it;
verses.textEn: For you have heard of my previous way of life in Judaism, how intensely I persecuted the church of God and tried to destroy it.

verses.textZh: 怎样在犹太教中比许多本族同辈的人更激进，为我祖先的传统分外热心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 怎样在犹太教中比许多本族同辈的人更激进，为我祖先的传统分外热心。
verses.textZhCuv: 我又在犹太教中，比我本国许多同岁的人更有长进，为我祖宗的遗传更加热心。
verses.textEnNiv: I was advancing in Judaism beyond many of my own age among my people and was extremely zealous for the traditions of my fathers.
verses.textEnEsv: And I was advancing in Judaism beyond many of my own age among my people, so extremely zealous was I for the traditions of my fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I advanced in Judaism beyond many of my contemporaries in my own nation, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: I was far ahead of my fellow Jews in my zeal for the traditions of my ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: and I was advancing in Judaism beyond many of my contemporaries among my countrymen, being more extremely zealous for my ancestral traditions.
verses.textEn: I was advancing in Judaism beyond many of my own age among my people and was extremely zealous for the traditions of my fathers.

verses.textZh: 然而，当我在母腹里就把我分别出来，又用他的恩呼召我的那一位，
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而，当我在母腹里就把我分别出来，又用他的恩呼召我的那一位，
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，那把我从母腹里分别出来、又施恩召我的神，
verses.textEnNiv: But when God, who set me apart from my mother’s womb and called me by his grace, was pleased
verses.textEnEsv: But when he who had set me apart before I was born, and who called me by his grace,
verses.textEnNkjv: But when it pleased God, who separated me from my mother’s womb and called me through His grace,
verses.textEnNlt: But even before I was born, God chose me and called me by his marvelous grace. Then it pleased him
verses.textEnNasb: But when He who had set me apart even from my mother’s womb and called me through His grace was pleased
verses.textEn: But when God, who set me apart from my mother’s womb and called me by his grace, was pleased

verses.textZh: 既然乐意把自己的儿子启示给我，使我可以在外族人中传扬他，我就没有和任何人 商量，
verses.textZhCnvs: 既然乐意把自己的儿子启示给我，使我可以在外族人中传扬他，我就没有和任何人 商量，
verses.textZhCuv: 既然乐意将他儿子启示在我心里，叫我把他传在外邦人中，我就没有与属血气的人商量，
verses.textEnNiv: to reveal his Son in me so that I might preach him among the Gentiles, my immediate response was not to consult any human being.
verses.textEnEsv: was pleased to reveal his Son to me, in order that I might preach him among the Gentiles, I did not immediately consult with anyone;
verses.textEnNkjv: to reveal His Son in me, that I might preach Him among the Gentiles, I did not immediately confer with flesh and blood,
verses.textEnNlt: to reveal his Son to me so that I would proclaim the Good News about Jesus to the Gentiles. When this happened, I did not rush out to consult with any human being.
verses.textEnNasb: to reveal His Son in me so that I might preach Him among the Gentiles, I did not immediately consult with flesh and blood,
verses.textEn: to reveal his Son in me so that I might preach him among the Gentiles, my immediate response was not to consult any human being.

verses.textZh: 也没有上耶路撒冷见那些比我先作使徒的，却去了阿拉伯，然后再回到大马士革。
verses.textZhCnvs: 也没有上耶路撒冷见那些比我先作使徒的，却去了阿拉伯，然后再回到大马士革。
verses.textZhCuv: 也没有上耶路撒冷去见那些比我先作使徒的，惟独往阿拉伯去，后又回到大马士革。
verses.textEnNiv: I did not go up to Jerusalem to see those who were apostles before I was, but I went into Arabia. Later I returned to Damascus.
verses.textEnEsv: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia, and returned again to Damascus.
verses.textEnNkjv: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those whowere apostles before me; but I went to Arabia, and returned again to Damascus.
verses.textEnNlt: Nor did I go up to Jerusalem to consult with those who were apostles before I was. Instead, I went away into Arabia, and later I returned to the city of Damascus.
verses.textEnNasb: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me; but I went away to Arabia, and returned once more to Damascus.
verses.textEn: I did not go up to Jerusalem to see those who were apostles before I was, but I went into Arabia. Later I returned to Damascus.

verses.textZh: 过了三年，我才上耶路撒冷去见矶法，和他住了十五天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 过了三年，我才上耶路撒冷去见矶法，和他住了十五天。
verses.textZhCuv: 过了三年，才上耶路撒冷去见矶法，和他同住了十五天。
verses.textEnNiv: Then after three years, I went up to Jerusalem to get acquainted with Cephas and stayed with him fifteen days.
verses.textEnEsv: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Cephas and remained with him fifteen days.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Peter, and remained with him fifteen days.
verses.textEnNlt: Then three years later I went to Jerusalem to get to know Peter, and I stayed with him for fifteen days.
verses.textEnNasb: Then three years later I went up to Jerusalem to become acquainted with Cephas, and stayed with him for fifteen days.
verses.textEn: Then after three years, I went up to Jerusalem to get acquainted with Cephas and stayed with him fifteen days.

verses.textZh: 至于其余的使徒，除了主的弟弟雅各以外，我都没有见过。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于其余的使徒，除了主的弟弟雅各以外，我都没有见过。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于别的使徒，除了主的兄弟雅各，我都没有看见。
verses.textEnNiv: I saw none of the other apostles—only James, the Lord’s brother.
verses.textEnEsv: But I saw none of the other apostles except James the Lord’s brother.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I saw none of the other apostles except James, the Lord’s brother.
verses.textEnNlt: The only other apostle I met at that time was James, the Lord’s brother.
verses.textEnNasb: But I did not see another one of the apostles except James, the Lord’s brother.
verses.textEn: I saw none of the other apostles—only James, the Lord’s brother.

verses.textZh: 在神面前我敢说，我写给你们的都不是谎话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在神面前我敢说，我写给你们的都不是谎话。
verses.textZhCuv: 我写给你们的不是谎话，这是我在神面前说的。
verses.textEnNiv: I assure you before God that what I am writing you is no lie.
verses.textEnEsv: (In what I am writing to you, before God, I do not lie!)
verses.textEnNkjv: (Now concerning the things which I write to you, indeed, before God, I do not lie.)
verses.textEnNlt: I declare before God that what I am writing to you is not a lie.
verses.textEnNasb: (Now in what I am writing to you, I assure you before God that I am not lying.)
verses.textEn: I assure you before God that what I am writing you is no lie.

verses.textZh: 后来，我到了叙利亚和基利家一带的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来，我到了叙利亚和基利家一带的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 以后我到了叙利亚和基利家境内。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I went to Syria and Cilicia.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I went into the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
verses.textEnNkjv: Afterward I went into the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
verses.textEnNlt: After that visit I went north into the provinces of Syria and Cilicia.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I went into the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
verses.textEn: Then I went to Syria and Cilicia.

verses.textZh: 那时，在基督里的犹太众教会还没有见过我的面，
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，在基督里的犹太众教会还没有见过我的面，
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，犹太信基督的各教会都没有见过我的面。
verses.textEnNiv: I was personally unknown to the churches of Judea that are in Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: And I was still unknown in person to the churches of Judea that are in Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I was unknown by face to the churches of Judea which were in Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: And still the churches in Christ that are in Judea didn’t know me personally.
verses.textEnNasb: I was still unknown by sight to the churches of Judea which are in Christ;
verses.textEn: I was personally unknown to the churches of Judea that are in Christ.

verses.textZh: 不过听说"那个从前迫害我们的，现在竟然传扬他以前所残害的信仰"，
verses.textZhCnvs: 不过听说"那个从前迫害我们的，现在竟然传扬他以前所残害的信仰"，
verses.textZhCuv: 不过听说那从前逼迫我们的，现在传扬他原先所残害的真道。
verses.textEnNiv: They only heard the report: "The man who formerly persecuted us is now preaching the faith he once tried to destroy."
verses.textEnEsv: They only were hearing it said, "He who used to persecute us is now preaching the faith he once tried to destroy."
verses.textEnNkjv: But they were hearing only, "He who formerly persecuted us now preaches the faith which he once triedto destroy."
verses.textEnNlt: All they knew was that people were saying, "The one who used to persecute us is now preaching the very faith he tried to destroy!"
verses.textEnNasb: but they only kept hearing, "The man who once persecuted us is now preaching the faith which he once tried to destroy."
verses.textEn: They only heard the report: "The man who formerly persecuted us is now preaching the faith he once tried to destroy."

verses.textZh: 他们就因着我的缘故颂赞神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就因着我的缘故颂赞神。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就为我的缘故，归荣耀给神。
verses.textEnNiv: And they praised God because of me.
verses.textEnEsv: And they glorified God because of me.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they glorified God in me.
verses.textEnNlt: And they praised God because of me.
verses.textEnNasb: And they were glorifying God because of me.
verses.textEn: And they praised God because of me.

verses.textZh: 过了十四年，我再次上耶路撒冷去，这次是和巴拿巴，并且带着提多一同去的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 过了十四年，我再次上耶路撒冷去，这次是和巴拿巴，并且带着提多一同去的。
verses.textZhCuv: 过了十四年，我同巴拿巴又上耶路撒冷去，并带着提多同去。
verses.textEnNiv: Then after fourteen years, I went up again to Jerusalem, this time with Barnabas. I took Titus along also.
verses.textEnEsv: Then after fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus along with me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then after fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, and also took Titus with me.
verses.textEnNlt: Then fourteen years later I went back to Jerusalem again, this time with Barnabas; and Titus came along, too.
verses.textEnNasb: Then after an interval of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus along also.
verses.textEn: Then after fourteen years, I went up again to Jerusalem, this time with Barnabas. I took Titus along also.

verses.textZh: 我是顺从启示去的；在那里我对他们说明我在外族人中所传的福音，私下讲了给那些有名望的人听，免得我从前或现在都白跑了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我是顺从启示去的；在那里我对他们说明我在外族人中所传的福音，私下讲了给那些有名望的人听，免得我从前或现在都白跑了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我是奉启示上去的，把我在外邦人中所传的福音对弟兄们陈说；却是背地里对那有名望之人说的，惟恐我现在，或是从前，徒然奔跑。
verses.textEnNiv: I went in response to a revelation and, meeting privately with those esteemed as leaders, I presented to them the gospel that I preach among the Gentiles. I wanted to be sure I was not running and had not been running my race in vain.
verses.textEnEsv: I went up because of a revelation and set before them (though privately before those who seemed influential) the gospel that I proclaim among the Gentiles, in order to make sure I was not running or had not run in vain.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I went up by revelation, and communicated to them that gospel which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately to those who were of reputation, lest by any means I might run, or had run, in vain.
verses.textEnNlt: I went there because God revealed to me that I should go. While I was there I met privately with those considered to be leaders of the church and shared with them the message I had been preaching to the Gentiles. I wanted to make sure that we were in agreement, for fear that all my efforts had been wasted and I was running the race for nothing.
verses.textEnNasb: It was because of a revelation that I went up; and I submitted to them the gospel which I preach among the Gentiles, but I did so in private to those who were of reputation, for fear that somehow I might be running, or had run, in vain.
verses.textEn: I went in response to a revelation and, meeting privately with those esteemed as leaders, I presented to them the gospel that I preach among the Gentiles. I wanted to be sure I was not running and had not been running my race in vain.

verses.textZh: 与我同行的提多，虽然是希腊人，也没有强迫他受割礼；
verses.textZhCnvs: 与我同行的提多，虽然是希腊人，也没有强迫他受割礼；
verses.textZhCuv: 但与我同去的提多，虽是希腊人，也没有勉强他受割礼；
verses.textEnNiv: Yet not even Titus, who was with me, was compelled to be circumcised, even though he was a Greek.
verses.textEnEsv: But even Titus, who was with me, was not forced to be circumcised, though he was a Greek.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet not even Titus who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.
verses.textEnNlt: And they supported me and did not even demand that my companion Titus be circumcised, though he was a Gentile.
verses.textEnNasb: But not even Titus, who was with me, though he was a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.
verses.textEn: Yet not even Titus, who was with me, was compelled to be circumcised, even though he was a Greek.

verses.textZh: 这是因为有些混进来的假弟兄，暗暗地来侦查我们在基督耶稣里享有的自由，为的是要辖制我们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是因为有些混进来的假弟兄，暗暗地来侦查我们在基督耶稣里享有的自由，为的是要辖制我们。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为有偷着引进来的假弟兄，私下窥探我们在基督耶稣里的自由，要叫我们作奴仆。
verses.textEnNiv: This matter arose because some false believers had infiltrated our ranks to spy on the freedom we have in Christ Jesus and to make us slaves.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet because of false brothers secretly brought in—who slipped in to spy out our freedom that we have in Christ Jesus, so that they might bring us into slavery—
verses.textEnNkjv: And thisoccurred because of false brethren secretly brought in (who came in by stealth to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage),
verses.textEnNlt: Even that question came up only because of some so-called believers there—false ones, really —who were secretly brought in. They sneaked in to spy on us and take away the freedom we have in Christ Jesus. They wanted to enslave us and force us to follow their Jewish regulations.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet it was a concern because of the false brothers secretly brought in, who had sneaked in to spy on our freedom which we have in Christ Jesus, in order to enslave us.
verses.textEn: This matter arose because some false believers had infiltrated our ranks to spy on the freedom we have in Christ Jesus and to make us slaves.

verses.textZh: 对这些人，我们一点也没有让步妥协，为了要使福音的真理存留在你们中间。
verses.textZhCnvs: 对这些人，我们一点也没有让步妥协，为了要使福音的真理存留在你们中间。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们就是一刻的工夫也没有容让顺服他们，为要叫福音的真理仍存在你们中间。
verses.textEnNiv: We did not give in to them for a moment, so that the truth of the gospel might be preserved for you.
verses.textEnEsv: to them we did not yield in submission even for a moment, so that the truth of the gospel might be preserved for you.
verses.textEnNkjv: to whom we did not yield submission even for an hour, that the truth of the gospel might continue with you.
verses.textEnNlt: But we refused to give in to them for a single moment. We wanted to preserve the truth of the gospel message for you.
verses.textEnNasb: But we did not yield in subjection to them, even for an hour, so that the truth of the gospel would remain with you.
verses.textEn: We did not give in to them for a moment, so that the truth of the gospel might be preserved for you.

verses.textZh: 至于那些被认为有名望的人 ，他们并没有给我增加甚么；
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于那些被认为有名望的人 ，他们并没有给我增加甚么；
verses.textZhCuv: 至于那些有名望的，不论他是何等人，都与我无干。神不以外貌取人。那些有名望的，并没有加增我什么，
verses.textEnNiv: As for those who were held in high esteem—whatever they were makes no difference to me; God does not show favoritism—they added nothing to my message.
verses.textEnEsv: And from those who seemed to be influential (what they were makes no difference to me; God shows no partiality)—those, I say, who seemed influential added nothing to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: But from those who seemed to be something—whatever they were, it makes no difference to me; God shows personal favoritism to no man—for those who seemed tobesomething added nothing to me.
verses.textEnNlt: And the leaders of the church had nothing to add to what I was preaching. (By the way, their reputation as great leaders made no difference to me, for God has no favorites.)
verses.textEnNasb: But from those who were of considerable repute (what they were makes no difference to me; God shows no favoritism)—well, those who were of repute contributed nothing to me.
verses.textEn: As for those who were held in high esteem—whatever they were makes no difference to me; God does not show favoritism—they added nothing to my message.

verses.textZh: 反而因为看见我受托传福音给没有受割礼的人，就像彼得受托传福音给受割礼的人一样，
verses.textZhCnvs: 反而因为看见我受托传福音给没有受割礼的人，就像彼得受托传福音给受割礼的人一样，
verses.textZhCuv: 反倒看见了主托我传福音给那未受割礼的人，正如托彼得传福音给那受割礼的人。（
verses.textEnNiv: On the contrary, they recognized that I had been entrusted with the task of preaching the gospel to the uncircumcised, just as Peter had been to the circumcised.
verses.textEnEsv: On the contrary, when they saw that I had been entrusted with the gospel to the uncircumcised, just as Peter had been entrusted with the gospel to the circumcised
verses.textEnNkjv: But on the contrary, when they saw that the gospel for the uncircumcised had been committed to me, as thegospel for the circumcised was to Peter
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, they saw that God had given me the responsibility of preaching the gospel to the Gentiles, just as he had given Peter the responsibility of preaching to the Jews.
verses.textEnNasb: But on the contrary, seeing that I had been entrusted with the gospel to the uncircumcised, just as Peter had been to the circumcised
verses.textEn: On the contrary, they recognized that I had been entrusted with the task of preaching the gospel to the uncircumcised, just as Peter had been to the circumcised.

verses.textZh: 又知道我蒙了神的恩，那几位被誉为柱石的雅各、矶法和约翰，就向我和巴拿巴伸出右手互相许诺，我们要到外族人那里去传福音，他们要到受割礼的人那里去传福音；
verses.textZhCnvs: 又知道我蒙了神的恩，那几位被誉为柱石的雅各、矶法和约翰，就向我和巴拿巴伸出右手互相许诺，我们要到外族人那里去传福音，他们要到受割礼的人那里去传福音；
verses.textZhCuv: 那感动彼得、叫他为受割礼之人作使徒的，也感动我，叫我为外邦人作使徒；）
verses.textEnNiv: For God, who was at work in Peter as an apostle to the circumcised, was also at work in me as an apostle to the Gentiles.
verses.textEnEsv: (for he who worked through Peter for his apostolic ministry to the circumcised worked also through me for mine to the Gentiles),
verses.textEnNkjv: (for He who worked effectively in Peter for the apostleship to the circumcised also worked effectively in me toward the Gentiles),
verses.textEnNlt: For the same God who worked through Peter as the apostle to the Jews also worked through me as the apostle to the Gentiles.
verses.textEnNasb: (for He who was at work for Peter in his apostleship to the circumcised was at work for me also to the Gentiles),
verses.textEn: For God, who was at work in Peter as an apostle to the circumcised, was also at work in me as an apostle to the Gentiles.

verses.textZh: 只是要我们记念穷人，这本来也是我一向热心作的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只是要我们记念穷人，这本来也是我一向热心作的。
verses.textZhCuv: 又知道所赐给我的恩典，那称为教会柱石的雅各、矶法、约翰，就向我和巴拿巴用右手行相交之礼，叫我们往外邦人那里去，他们往受割礼的人那里去。
verses.textEnNiv: James, Cephas and John, those esteemed as pillars, gave me and Barnabas the right hand of fellowship when they recognized the grace given to me. They agreed that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcised.
verses.textEnEsv: and when James and Cephas and John, who seemed to be pillars, perceived the grace that was given to me, they gave the right hand of fellowship to Barnabas and me, that we should go to the Gentiles and they to the circumcised.
verses.textEnNkjv: and when James, Cephas, and John, who seemed to be pillars, perceived the grace that had been given to me, they gave me and Barnabas the right hand of fellowship, that we shouldgo to the Gentiles and they to the circumcised.
verses.textEnNlt: In fact, James, Peter, and John, who were known as pillars of the church, recognized the gift God had given me, and they accepted Barnabas and me as their co-workers. They encouraged us to keep preaching to the Gentiles, while they continued their work with the Jews.
verses.textEnNasb: and recognizing the grace that had been given to me, James and Cephas and John, who were reputed to be pillars, gave to me and Barnabas the right hand of fellowship, so that we might go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcised.
verses.textEn: James, Cephas and John, those esteemed as pillars, gave me and Barnabas the right hand of fellowship when they recognized the grace given to me. They agreed that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcised.

verses.textZh: 可是，矶法到了安提阿的时候，因为他有该责备的地方，我就当面反对他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是，矶法到了安提阿的时候，因为他有该责备的地方，我就当面反对他。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是愿意我们记念穷人；这也是我本来热心去行的。
verses.textEnNiv: All they asked was that we should continue to remember the poor, the very thing I had been eager to do all along.
verses.textEnEsv: Only, they asked us to remember the poor, the very thing I was eager to do.
verses.textEnNkjv: Theydesired only that we should remember the poor, the very thing which I also was eager to do.
verses.textEnNlt: Their only suggestion was that we keep on helping the poor, which I have always been eager to do.
verses.textEnNasb: They only asked us to remember the poor—the very thing I also was eager to do.
verses.textEn: All they asked was that we should continue to remember the poor, the very thing I had been eager to do all along.

verses.textZh: 从雅各那里来的人还没有到以前，他和外族人一同吃饭；但他们来到了，他因为怕那些守割礼的人，就从外族人中退出来，和他们分开。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从雅各那里来的人还没有到以前，他和外族人一同吃饭；但他们来到了，他因为怕那些守割礼的人，就从外族人中退出来，和他们分开。
verses.textZhCuv: 后来，矶法到了安提阿；因他有可责之处，我就当面抵挡他。
verses.textEnNiv: When Cephas came to Antioch, I opposed him to his face, because he stood condemned.
verses.textEnEsv: But when Cephas came to Antioch, I opposed him to his face, because he stood condemned.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when Peter had come to Antioch, I withstood him to his face, because he was to be blamed;
verses.textEnNlt: But when Peter came to Antioch, I had to oppose him to his face, for what he did was very wrong.
verses.textEnNasb: But when Cephas came to Antioch, I opposed him to his face, because he stood condemned.
verses.textEn: When Cephas came to Antioch, I opposed him to his face, because he stood condemned.

verses.textZh: 其余的犹太人也和他一同装假，甚至连巴拿巴也受了影响，跟着他们装假。
verses.textZhCnvs: 其余的犹太人也和他一同装假，甚至连巴拿巴也受了影响，跟着他们装假。
verses.textZhCuv: 从雅各那里来的人未到以先，他和外邦人一同吃饭，及至他们来到，他因怕奉割礼的人，就退去与外邦人隔开了。
verses.textEnNiv: For before certain men came from James, he used to eat with the Gentiles. But when they arrived, he began to draw back and separate himself from the Gentiles because he was afraid of those who belonged to the circumcision group.
verses.textEnEsv: For before certain men came from James, he was eating with the Gentiles; but when they came he drew back and separated himself, fearing the circumcision party.
verses.textEnNkjv: for before certain men came from James, he would eat with the Gentiles; but when they came, he withdrew and separated himself, fearing those who were of the circumcision.
verses.textEnNlt: When he first arrived, he ate with the Gentile believers, who were not circumcised. But afterward, when some friends of James came, Peter wouldn’t eat with the Gentiles anymore. He was afraid of criticism from these people who insisted on the necessity of circumcision.
verses.textEnNasb: For prior to the coming of some men from James, he used to eat with the Gentiles; but when they came, he began to withdraw and separate himself, fearing those from the circumcision.
verses.textEn: For before certain men came from James, he used to eat with the Gentiles. But when they arrived, he began to draw back and separate himself from the Gentiles because he was afraid of those who belonged to the circumcision group.

verses.textZh: 但我一见他们所行的不合福音的真理，就当众对矶法说："你是犹太人，生活既然像外族人而不像犹太人，怎么还勉强外族人跟随犹太人的规矩呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但我一见他们所行的不合福音的真理，就当众对矶法说："你是犹太人，生活既然像外族人而不像犹太人，怎么还勉强外族人跟随犹太人的规矩呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 其余的犹太人也都随着他装假，甚至连巴拿巴也随伙装假。
verses.textEnNiv: The other Jews joined him in his hypocrisy, so that by their hypocrisy even Barnabas was led astray.
verses.textEnEsv: And the rest of the Jews acted hypocritically along with him, so that even Barnabas was led astray by their hypocrisy.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the rest of the Jews also played the hypocrite with him, so that even Barnabas was carried away with their hypocrisy.
verses.textEnNlt: As a result, other Jewish believers followed Peter’s hypocrisy, and even Barnabas was led astray by their hypocrisy.
verses.textEnNasb: The rest of the Jews joined him in hypocrisy, with the result that even Barnabas was carried away by their hypocrisy.
verses.textEn: The other Jews joined him in his hypocrisy, so that by their hypocrisy even Barnabas was led astray.

verses.textZh: 我们生来是犹太人，不是外族中的罪人；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们生来是犹太人，不是外族中的罪人；
verses.textZhCuv: 但我一看见他们行的不正，与福音的真理不合，就在众人面前对矶法说：「你既是犹太人，若随外邦人行事，不随犹太人行事，怎么还勉强外邦人随犹太人呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: When I saw that they were not acting in line with the truth of the gospel, I said to Cephas in front of them all, "You are a Jew, yet you live like a Gentile and not like a Jew. How is it, then, that you force Gentiles to follow Jewish customs?
verses.textEnEsv: But when I saw that their conduct was not in step with the truth of the gospel, I said to Cephas before them all, "If you, though a Jew, live like a Gentile and not like a Jew, how can you force the Gentiles to live like Jews?"
verses.textEnNkjv: But when I saw that they were not straightforward about the truth of the gospel, I said to Peter before them all, "If you, being a Jew, live in the manner of Gentiles and not as the Jews, why do you compel Gentiles to live as Jews?
verses.textEnNlt: When I saw that they were not following the truth of the gospel message, I said to Peter in front of all the others, "Since you, a Jew by birth, have discarded the Jewish laws and are living like a Gentile, why are you now trying to make these Gentiles follow the Jewish traditions?
verses.textEnNasb: But when I saw that they were not straightforward about the truth of the gospel, I said to Cephas in the presence of all, "If you, being a Jew, live like the Gentiles and not like the Jews, how is it that you compel the Gentiles to live like Jews?
verses.textEn: When I saw that they were not acting in line with the truth of the gospel, I said to Cephas in front of them all, "You are a Jew, yet you live like a Gentile and not like a Jew. How is it, then, that you force Gentiles to follow Jewish customs?

verses.textZh: 既然知道人称义不是靠行律法，而是因信耶稣基督，我们也就信了基督耶稣，使我们因信基督称义，不是靠行律法；因为没有人能靠行律法称义。
verses.textZhCnvs: 既然知道人称义不是靠行律法，而是因信耶稣基督，我们也就信了基督耶稣，使我们因信基督称义，不是靠行律法；因为没有人能靠行律法称义。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们这生来的犹太人，不是外邦的罪人；
verses.textEnNiv: "We who are Jews by birth and not sinful Gentiles
verses.textEnEsv: We ourselves are Jews by birth and not Gentile sinners;
verses.textEnNkjv: We whoare Jews by nature, and not sinners of the Gentiles,
verses.textEnNlt: "You and I are Jews by birth, not ‘sinners’ like the Gentiles.
verses.textEnNasb: "We are Jews by nature and not sinners from the Gentiles;
verses.textEn: "We who are Jews by birth and not sinful Gentiles

verses.textZh: 如果我们寻求在基督里称义，却仍然是罪人，难道基督是使人犯罪的吗？绝对不是。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果我们寻求在基督里称义，却仍然是罪人，难道基督是使人犯罪的吗？绝对不是。
verses.textZhCuv: 既知道人称义不是因行律法，乃是因信耶稣基督，连我们也信了基督耶稣，使我们因信基督称义，不因行律法称义；因为凡有血气的，没有一人因行律法称义。
verses.textEnNiv: know that a person is not justified by the works of the law, but by faith in Jesus Christ. So we, too, have put our faith in Christ Jesus that we may be justified by faith in Christ and not by the works of the law, because by the works of the law no one will be justified.
verses.textEnEsv: yet we know that a person is not justified by works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ, so we also have believed in Christ Jesus, in order to be justified by faith in Christ and not by works of the law, because by works of the law no one will be justified.
verses.textEnNkjv: knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law but by faith in Jesus Christ, even we have believed in Christ Jesus, that we might be justified by faith in Christ and not by the works of the law; for by the works of the law no flesh shall be justified.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet we know that a person is made right with God by faith in Jesus Christ, not by obeying the law. And we have believed in Christ Jesus, so that we might be made right with God because of our faith in Christ, not because we have obeyed the law. For no one will ever be made right with God by obeying the law."
verses.textEnNasb: nevertheless, knowing that a person is not justified by works of the Law but through faith in Christ Jesus, even we have believed in Christ Jesus, so that we may be justified by faith in Christ and not by works of the Law; since by works of the Law no flesh will be justified.
verses.textEn: know that a person is not justified by the works of the law, but by faith in Jesus Christ. So we, too, have put our faith in Christ Jesus that we may be justified by faith in Christ and not by the works of the law, because by the works of the law no one will be justified.

verses.textZh: 我若重建我所拆毁的，就证明自己是个有过犯的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我若重建我所拆毁的，就证明自己是个有过犯的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们若求在基督里称义，却仍旧是罪人，难道基督是叫人犯罪的吗？断乎不是！
verses.textEnNiv: "But if, in seeking to be justified in Christ, we Jews find ourselves also among the sinners, doesn’t that mean that Christ promotes sin? Absolutely not!
verses.textEnEsv: But if, in our endeavor to be justified in Christ, we too were found to be sinners, is Christ then a servant of sin? Certainly not!
verses.textEnNkjv: "But if, while we seek to be justified by Christ, we ourselves also are found sinners, is Christ therefore a minister of sin? Certainly not!
verses.textEnNlt: But suppose we seek to be made right with God through faith in Christ and then we are found guilty because we have abandoned the law. Would that mean Christ has led us into sin? Absolutely not!
verses.textEnNasb: But if, while seeking to be justified in Christ, we ourselves have also been found sinners, is Christ then a servant of sin? Far from it!
verses.textEn: "But if, in seeking to be justified in Christ, we Jews find ourselves also among the sinners, doesn’t that mean that Christ promotes sin? Absolutely not!

verses.textZh: 我借着律法已经向律法死了，使我可以向神活着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我借着律法已经向律法死了，使我可以向神活着。
verses.textZhCuv: 我素来所拆毁的，若重新建造，这就证明自己是犯罪的人。
verses.textEnNiv: If I rebuild what I destroyed, then I really would be a lawbreaker.
verses.textEnEsv: For if I rebuild what I tore down, I prove myself to be a transgressor.
verses.textEnNkjv: For if I build again those things which I destroyed, I make myself a transgressor.
verses.textEnNlt: Rather, I am a sinner if I rebuild the old system of law I already tore down.
verses.textEnNasb: For if I rebuild what I have once destroyed, I prove myself to be a wrongdoer.
verses.textEn: If I rebuild what I destroyed, then I really would be a lawbreaker.

verses.textZh: 我已经与基督同钉十字架；现在活着的，不再是我，而是基督活在我里面；如今在肉身中活着的我，是因信神的儿子而活的；他爱我，为我舍己。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我已经与基督同钉十字架；现在活着的，不再是我，而是基督活在我里面；如今在肉身中活着的我，是因信神的儿子而活的；他爱我，为我舍己。
verses.textZhCuv: 我因律法，就向律法死了，叫我可以向神活着。
verses.textEnNiv: "For through the law I died to the law so that I might live for God.
verses.textEnEsv: For through the law I died to the law, so that I might live to God.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I through the law died to the law that I might live to God.
verses.textEnNlt: For when I tried to keep the law, it condemned me. So I died to the law—I stopped trying to meet all its requirements—so that I might live for God.
verses.textEnNasb: For through the Law I died to the Law, so that I might live for God.
verses.textEn: "For through the law I died to the law so that I might live for God.

verses.textZh: 我不废弃神的恩；如果义是借着律法而来的，基督就白白地死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我不废弃神的恩；如果义是借着律法而来的，基督就白白地死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我已经与基督同钉十字架，现在活着的不再是我，乃是基督在我里面活着；并且我如今在肉身活着，是因信神的儿子而活；他是爱我，为我舍己。
verses.textEnNiv: I have been crucified with Christ and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me. The life I now live in the body, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself for me.
verses.textEnEsv: I have been crucified with Christ. It is no longer I who live, but Christ who lives in me. And the life I now live in the flesh I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself for me.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have been crucified with Christ; it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me; and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave Himself for me.
verses.textEnNlt: My old self has been crucified with Christ. It is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me. So I live in this earthly body by trusting in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself for me.
verses.textEnNasb: I have been crucified with Christ; and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me; and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave Himself up for me.
verses.textEn: I have been crucified with Christ and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me. The life I now live in the body, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself for me.

verses.textZh: 我不废掉神的恩；义若是藉着律法得的，基督就是徒然死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我不废掉神的恩；义若是藉着律法得的，基督就是徒然死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我不废掉神的恩；义若是藉着律法得的，基督就是徒然死了。
verses.textEnNiv: I do not set aside the grace of God, for if righteousness could be gained through the law, Christ died for nothing!"
verses.textEnEsv: I do not nullify the grace of God, for if righteousness were through the law, then Christ died for no purpose.
verses.textEnNkjv: I do not set aside the grace of God; for if righteousness comes through the law, then Christ died in vain."
verses.textEnNlt: I do not treat the grace of God as meaningless. For if keeping the law could make us right with God, then there was no need for Christ to die.
verses.textEnNasb: I do not nullify the grace of God, for if righteousness comes through the Law, then Christ died needlessly."
verses.textEn: I do not set aside the grace of God, for if righteousness could be gained through the law, Christ died for nothing!"

verses.textZh: 无知的加拉太人哪！耶稣基督钉十字架，已经活现在你们眼前，谁又迷惑了你们呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 无知的加拉太人哪！耶稣基督钉十字架，已经活现在你们眼前，谁又迷惑了你们呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 无知的加拉太人哪，耶稣基督钉十字架，已经活画在你们眼前，谁又迷惑了你们呢？
verses.textEnNiv: You foolish Galatians! Who has bewitched you? Before your very eyes Jesus Christ was clearly portrayed as crucified.
verses.textEnEsv: O foolish Galatians! Who has bewitched you? It was before your eyes that Jesus Christ was publicly portrayed as crucified.
verses.textEnNkjv: O foolish Galatians! Who has bewitched you that you should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was clearly portrayed among you as crucified?
verses.textEnNlt: Oh, foolish Galatians! Who has cast an evil spell on you? For the meaning of Jesus Christ’s death was made as clear to you as if you had seen a picture of his death on the cross.
verses.textEnNasb: You foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was publicly portrayed as crucified?
verses.textEn: You foolish Galatians! Who has bewitched you? Before your very eyes Jesus Christ was clearly portrayed as crucified.

verses.textZh: 我只想问你们这一点：你们接受了圣灵，是靠着行律法，还是因为信所听见的福音呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我只想问你们这一点：你们接受了圣灵，是靠着行律法，还是因为信所听见的福音呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 我只要问你们这一件：你们受了圣灵，是因行律法呢？是因听信福音呢？
verses.textEnNiv: I would like to learn just one thing from you: Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by believing what you heard?
verses.textEnEsv: Let me ask you only this: Did you receive the Spirit by works of the law or by hearing with faith?
verses.textEnNkjv: This only I want to learn from you: Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
verses.textEnNlt: Let me ask you this one question: Did you receive the Holy Spirit by obeying the law of Moses? Of course not! You received the Spirit because you believed the message you heard about Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: This is the only thing I want to find out from you: did you receive the Spirit by works of the Law, or by hearing with faith?
verses.textEn: I would like to learn just one thing from you: Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by believing what you heard?

verses.textZh: 你们是这样的无知吗？你们既然靠着圣灵开始，现在还要靠着肉体成全吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们是这样的无知吗？你们既然靠着圣灵开始，现在还要靠着肉体成全吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们既靠圣灵入门，如今还靠肉身成全吗？你们是这样的无知吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Are you so foolish? After beginning by means of the Spirit, are you now trying to finish by means of the flesh?
verses.textEnEsv: Are you so foolish? Having begun by the Spirit, are you now being perfected by the flesh?
verses.textEnNkjv: Are you so foolish? Having begun in the Spirit, are you now being made perfect by the flesh?
verses.textEnNlt: How foolish can you be? After starting your new lives in the Spirit, why are you now trying to become perfect by your own human effort?
verses.textEnNasb: Are you so foolish? Having begun by the Spirit, are you now being perfected by the flesh?
verses.textEn: Are you so foolish? After beginning by means of the Spirit, are you now trying to finish by means of the flesh?

verses.textZh: 你们受了这么多的苦，都是白受的吗？恐怕真是白受的了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们受了这么多的苦，都是白受的吗？恐怕真是白受的了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们受苦如此之多，都是徒然的吗？难道果真是徒然的吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Have you experienced so much in vain—if it really was in vain?
verses.textEnEsv: Did you suffer so many things in vain—if indeed it was in vain?
verses.textEnNkjv: Have you suffered so many things in vain—if indeed itwas in vain?
verses.textEnNlt: Have you experienced so much for nothing? Surely it was not in vain, was it?
verses.textEnNasb: Did you suffer so many things in vain—if indeed it was in vain?
verses.textEn: Have you experienced so much in vain—if it really was in vain?

verses.textZh: 那么，神赐圣灵给你们，又在你们中间行神迹，是因为你们行律法，还是因为你们信所听见的福音呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 那么，神赐圣灵给你们，又在你们中间行神迹，是因为你们行律法，还是因为你们信所听见的福音呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 那赐给你们圣灵，又在你们中间行异能的，是因你们行律法呢？是因你们听信福音呢？
verses.textEnNiv: So again I ask, does God give you his Spirit and work miracles among you by the works of the law, or by your believing what you heard?
verses.textEnEsv: Does he who supplies the Spirit to you and works miracles among you do so by works of the law, or by hearing with faith—
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore He who supplies the Spirit to you and works miracles among you, doesHedoit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?—
verses.textEnNlt: I ask you again, does God give you the Holy Spirit and work miracles among you because you obey the law? Of course not! It is because you believe the message you heard about Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: So then, does He who provides you with the Spirit and works miracles among you, do it by works of the Law, or by hearing with faith?
verses.textEn: So again I ask, does God give you his Spirit and work miracles among you by the works of the law, or by your believing what you heard?

verses.textZh: 正如亚伯拉罕信神，这就算为他的义。
verses.textZhCnvs: 正如亚伯拉罕信神，这就算为他的义。
verses.textZhCuv: 正如「亚伯拉罕信神，这就算为他的义」。
verses.textEnNiv: So also Abraham "believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness."
verses.textEnEsv: just as Abraham "believed God, and it was counted to him as righteousness"?
verses.textEnNkjv: just as Abraham "believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness."
verses.textEnNlt: In the same way, "Abraham believed God, and God counted him as righteous because of his faith."
verses.textEnNasb: Just as Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness.
verses.textEn: So also Abraham "believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness."

verses.textZh: 所以你们要知道，有信心的人，就是亚伯拉罕的子孙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以你们要知道，有信心的人，就是亚伯拉罕的子孙。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，你们要知道：那以信为本的人，就是亚伯拉罕的子孙。
verses.textEnNiv: Understand, then, that those who have faith are children of Abraham.
verses.textEnEsv: Know then that it is those of faith who are the sons of Abraham.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore know that only those who are of faith are sons of Abraham.
verses.textEnNlt: The real children of Abraham, then, are those who put their faith in God.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, recognize that it is those who are of faith who are sons of Abraham.
verses.textEn: Understand, then, that those who have faith are children of Abraham.

verses.textZh: 圣经既然预先看见神要使外族人因信称义，就预先把好信息传给亚伯拉罕："万国都必因你得福。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 圣经既然预先看见神要使外族人因信称义，就预先把好信息传给亚伯拉罕："万国都必因你得福。"
verses.textZhCuv: 并且圣经既然预先看明，神要叫外邦人因信称义，就早已传福音给亚伯拉罕，说：「万国都必因你得福。」
verses.textEnNiv: Scripture foresaw that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, and announced the gospel in advance to Abraham: "All nations will be blessed through you."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, preached the gospel beforehand to Abraham, saying, "In you shall all the nations be blessed."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, preached the gospel to Abraham beforehand, saying, "In you all the nations shall be blessed."
verses.textEnNlt: What’s more, the Scriptures looked forward to this time when God would make the Gentiles right in his sight because of their faith. God proclaimed this good news to Abraham long ago when he said, "All nations will be blessed through you."
verses.textEnNasb: The Scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, preached the gospel beforehand to Abraham, saying, "All the nations will be blessed in you."
verses.textEn: Scripture foresaw that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, and announced the gospel in advance to Abraham: "All nations will be blessed through you."

verses.textZh: 这样看来，有信心的人，必定和有信心的亚伯拉罕一同得福。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样看来，有信心的人，必定和有信心的亚伯拉罕一同得福。
verses.textZhCuv: 可见那以信为本的人和有信心的亚伯拉罕一同得福。
verses.textEnNiv: So those who rely on faith are blessed along with Abraham, the man of faith.
verses.textEnEsv: So then, those who are of faith are blessed along with Abraham, the man of faith.
verses.textEnNkjv: So then those who are of faith are blessed with believing Abraham.
verses.textEnNlt: So all who put their faith in Christ share the same blessing Abraham received because of his faith.
verses.textEnNasb: So then, those who are of faith are blessed with Abraham, the believer.
verses.textEn: So those who rely on faith are blessed along with Abraham, the man of faith.

verses.textZh: 凡是靠行律法称义的，都在咒诅之下，因为经上记着："凡不常常照着律法书上所写的一切去行的，都被咒诅。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡是靠行律法称义的，都在咒诅之下，因为经上记着："凡不常常照着律法书上所写的一切去行的，都被咒诅。"
verses.textZhCuv: 凡以行律法为本的，都是被咒诅的；因为经上记着：「凡不常照律法书上所记一切之事去行的，就被咒诅。」
verses.textEnNiv: For all who rely on the works of the law are under a curse, as it is written: "Cursed is everyone who does not continue to do everything written in the Book of the Law."
verses.textEnEsv: For all who rely on works of the law are under a curse; for it is written, "Cursed be everyone who does not abide by all things written in the Book of the Law, and do them."
verses.textEnNkjv: For as many as are of the works of the law are under the curse; for it is written, "Cursed is everyone who does not continue in all things which are written in the book of the law, to do them."
verses.textEnNlt: But those who depend on the law to make them right with God are under his curse, for the Scriptures say, "Cursed is everyone who does not observe and obey all the commands that are written in God’s Book of the Law."
verses.textEnNasb: For all who are of works of the Law are under a curse; for it is written: "Cursed is everyone who does not abide by all the things written in the book of the Law, to do them."
verses.textEn: For all who rely on the works of the law are under a curse, as it is written: "Cursed is everyone who does not continue to do everything written in the Book of the Law."

verses.textZh: 很明显，在神面前，没有一个人可以靠着律法称义，因为"义人必因信得生" 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 很明显，在神面前，没有一个人可以靠着律法称义，因为"义人必因信得生" 。
verses.textZhCuv: 没有一个人靠着律法在神面前称义，这是明显的；因为经上说：「义人必因信得生。」
verses.textEnNiv: Clearly no one who relies on the law is justified before God, because "the righteous will live by faith."
verses.textEnEsv: Now it is evident that no one is justified before God by the law, for "The righteous shall live by faith."
verses.textEnNkjv: But that no one is justified by the law in the sight of God is evident, for "the just shall live by faith."
verses.textEnNlt: So it is clear that no one can be made right with God by trying to keep the law. For the Scriptures say, "It is through faith that a righteous person has life."
verses.textEnNasb: Now, that no one is justified by the Law before God is evident; for, " the righteous one will live by faith."
verses.textEn: Clearly no one who relies on the law is justified before God, because "the righteous will live by faith."

verses.textZh: 律法本来不是出于信，而是说："遵行这些事的人，就必因这些事而活。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 律法本来不是出于信，而是说："遵行这些事的人，就必因这些事而活。"
verses.textZhCuv: 律法原不本乎信，只说：「行这些事的，就必因此活着。」
verses.textEnNiv: The law is not based on faith; on the contrary, it says, "The person who does these things will live by them."
verses.textEnEsv: But the law is not of faith, rather "The one who does them shall live by them."
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet the law is not of faith, but "the man who does them shall live by them."
verses.textEnNlt: This way of faith is very different from the way of law, which says, "It is through obeying the law that a person has life."
verses.textEnNasb: However, the Law is not of faith; on the contrary, "The person who performs them will live by them."
verses.textEn: The law is not based on faith; on the contrary, it says, "The person who does these things will live by them."

verses.textZh: 基督替我们受了咒诅，就救赎我们脱离了律法的咒诅，因为经上记着："凡挂在木头上的，都是受咒诅的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 基督替我们受了咒诅，就救赎我们脱离了律法的咒诅，因为经上记着："凡挂在木头上的，都是受咒诅的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 基督既为我们受 了咒诅，就赎出我们脱离律法的咒诅；因为经上记着：「凡挂在木头上都是被咒诅的。」
verses.textEnNiv: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law by becoming a curse for us, for it is written: "Cursed is everyone who is hung on a pole."
verses.textEnEsv: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law by becoming a curse for us—for it is written, "Cursed is everyone who is hanged on a tree"—
verses.textEnNkjv: Christ has redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us (for it is written, "Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree"),
verses.textEnNlt: But Christ has rescued us from the curse pronounced by the law. When he was hung on the cross, he took upon himself the curse for our wrongdoing. For it is written in the Scriptures, "Cursed is everyone who is hung on a tree."
verses.textEnNasb: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the Law, having become a curse for us—for it is written: "Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree"—
verses.textEn: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law by becoming a curse for us, for it is written: "Cursed is everyone who is hung on a pole."

verses.textZh: 这样，亚伯拉罕所蒙的福，就在耶稣基督里临到外族人，使我们因着信，可以领受所应许的圣灵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，亚伯拉罕所蒙的福，就在耶稣基督里临到外族人，使我们因着信，可以领受所应许的圣灵。
verses.textZhCuv: 这便叫亚伯拉罕的福，因基督耶稣可以临到外邦人，使我们因信得着所应许的圣灵。
verses.textEnNiv: He redeemed us in order that the blessing given to Abraham might come to the Gentiles through Christ Jesus, so that by faith we might receive the promise of the Spirit.
verses.textEnEsv: so that in Christ Jesus the blessing of Abraham might come to the Gentiles, so that we might receive the promised Spirit through faith.
verses.textEnNkjv: that the blessing of Abraham might come upon the Gentiles in Christ Jesus, that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.
verses.textEnNlt: Through Christ Jesus, God has blessed the Gentiles with the same blessing he promised to Abraham, so that we who are believers might receive the promised Holy Spirit through faith.
verses.textEnNasb: in order that in Christ Jesus the blessing of Abraham would come to the Gentiles, so that we would receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.
verses.textEn: He redeemed us in order that the blessing given to Abraham might come to the Gentiles through Christ Jesus, so that by faith we might receive the promise of the Spirit.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，我照着人的常理说：一个立好了的约，虽然是人所立的，却没有人可以废弃或增加。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，我照着人的常理说：一个立好了的约，虽然是人所立的，却没有人可以废弃或增加。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，我且照着人的常话说：虽然是人的文约，若已经立定了，就没有能废弃或加增的。
verses.textEnNiv: Brothers and sisters, let me take an example from everyday life. Just as no one can set aside or add to a human covenant that has been duly established, so it is in this case.
verses.textEnEsv: To give a human example, brothers: even with a man-made covenant, no one annuls it or adds to it once it has been ratified.
verses.textEnNkjv: Brethren, I speak in the manner of men: Though itis only a man’s covenant, yet ifitis confirmed, no one annuls or adds to it.
verses.textEnNlt: Dear brothers and sisters, here’s an example from everyday life. Just as no one can set aside or amend an irrevocable agreement, so it is in this case.
verses.textEnNasb: Brothers and sisters, I speak in terms of human relations: even though it is only a man’s covenant, yet when it has been ratified, no one sets it aside or adds conditions to it.
verses.textEn: Brothers and sisters, let me take an example from everyday life. Just as no one can set aside or add to a human covenant that has been duly established, so it is in this case.

verses.textZh: 那些应许本来是给亚伯拉罕和他的后裔的。神并没有说"给众后裔"，好象指着多数；而是说"给你的一个后裔"，指着一个，就是基督。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些应许本来是给亚伯拉罕和他的后裔的。神并没有说"给众后裔"，好象指着多数；而是说"给你的一个后裔"，指着一个，就是基督。
verses.textZhCuv: 所应许的原是向亚伯拉罕和他子孙说的。神并不是说「众子孙」，指着许多人，乃是说「你那一个子孙」，指着一个人，就是基督。
verses.textEnNiv: The promises were spoken to Abraham and to his seed. Scripture does not say "and to seeds," meaning many people, but "and to your seed," meaning one person, who is Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the promises were made to Abraham and to his offspring. It does not say, "And to offsprings," referring to many, but referring to one, "And to your offspring," who is Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now to Abraham and his Seed were the promises made. He does not say, "And to seeds," as of many, but as of one, "And to your Seed," who is Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: God gave the promises to Abraham and his child. And notice that the Scripture doesn’t say "to his children, " as if it meant many descendants. Rather, it says "to his child"—and that, of course, means Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the promises were spoken to Abraham and to his seed. He does not say, "And to seeds," as one would in referring to many, but rather as in referring to one, "And to your seed," that is, Christ.
verses.textEn: The promises were spoken to Abraham and to his seed. Scripture does not say "and to seeds," meaning many people, but "and to your seed," meaning one person, who is Christ.

verses.textZh: 我要这样说，神预先立好的约，那四百三十年后才有的律法，不能把它废掉，使那应许落空。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要这样说，神预先立好的约，那四百三十年后才有的律法，不能把它废掉，使那应许落空。
verses.textZhCuv: 我是这么说，神预先所立的约，不能被那四百三十年以后的律法废掉，叫应许归于虚空。
verses.textEnNiv: What I mean is this: The law, introduced 430 years later, does not set aside the covenant previously established by God and thus do away with the promise.
verses.textEnEsv: This is what I mean: the law, which came 430 years afterward, does not annul a covenant previously ratified by God, so as to make the promise void.
verses.textEnNkjv: And this I say, that the law, which was four hundred and thirty years later, cannot annul the covenant that was confirmed before by God in Christ, that it should make the promise of no effect.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what I am trying to say: The agreement God made with Abraham could not be canceled 430 years later when God gave the law to Moses. God would be breaking his promise.
verses.textEnNasb: What I am saying is this: the Law, which came 430 years later, does not invalidate a covenant previously ratified by God, so as to nullify the promise.
verses.textEn: What I mean is this: The law, introduced 430 years later, does not set aside the covenant previously established by God and thus do away with the promise.

verses.textZh: 因为所承受的，如果是出于律法，就不是出于应许；但神是凭着应许赐给了亚伯拉罕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为所承受的，如果是出于律法，就不是出于应许；但神是凭着应许赐给了亚伯拉罕。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为承受产业，若本乎律法，就不本乎应许；但神是凭着应许把产业赐给亚伯拉罕。
verses.textEnNiv: For if the inheritance depends on the law, then it no longer depends on the promise; but God in his grace gave it to Abraham through a promise.
verses.textEnEsv: For if the inheritance comes by the law, it no longer comes by promise; but God gave it to Abraham by a promise.
verses.textEnNkjv: For if the inheritance is of the law, itis no longer of promise; but God gave it to Abraham by promise.
verses.textEnNlt: For if the inheritance could be received by keeping the law, then it would not be the result of accepting God’s promise. But God graciously gave it to Abraham as a promise.
verses.textEnNasb: For if the inheritance is based on law, it is no longer based on a promise; but God has granted it to Abraham by means of a promise.
verses.textEn: For if the inheritance depends on the law, then it no longer depends on the promise; but God in his grace gave it to Abraham through a promise.

verses.textZh: 那么，为甚么要有律法呢？是为了过犯的缘故才加上的，直到那得应许的后裔来到。律法是借着天使经中保的手设立的；
verses.textZhCnvs: 那么，为甚么要有律法呢？是为了过犯的缘故才加上的，直到那得应许的后裔来到。律法是借着天使经中保的手设立的；
verses.textZhCuv: 这样说来，律法是为什么有的呢？原是为过犯添上的，等候那蒙应许的子孙来到，并且是藉天使经中保之手设立的。
verses.textEnNiv: Why, then, was the law given at all? It was added because of transgressions until the Seed to whom the promise referred had come. The law was given through angels and entrusted to a mediator.
verses.textEnEsv: Why then the law? It was added because of transgressions, until the offspring should come to whom the promise had been made, and it was put in place through angels by an intermediary.
verses.textEnNkjv: What purpose then does the law serve? It was added because of transgressions, till the Seed should come to whom the promise was made; anditwas appointed through angels by the hand of a mediator.
verses.textEnNlt: Why, then, was the law given? It was given alongside the promise to show people their sins. But the law was designed to last only until the coming of the child who was promised. God gave his law through angels to Moses, who was the mediator between God and the people.
verses.textEnNasb: Why the Law then? It was added on account of the violations, having been ordered through angels at the hand of a mediator, until the Seed would come to whom the promise had been made.
verses.textEn: Why, then, was the law given at all? It was added because of transgressions until the Seed to whom the promise referred had come. The law was given through angels and entrusted to a mediator.

verses.textZh: 中保不是为单方面的，但神却是一位。
verses.textZhCnvs: 中保不是为单方面的，但神却是一位。
verses.textZhCuv: 但中保本不是为一面作的；神却是一位。
verses.textEnNiv: A mediator, however, implies more than one party; but God is one.
verses.textEnEsv: Now an intermediary implies more than one, but God is one.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now a mediator does not mediate for one only, but God is one.
verses.textEnNlt: Now a mediator is helpful if more than one party must reach an agreement. But God, who is one, did not use a mediator when he gave his promise to Abraham.
verses.textEnNasb: Now a mediator is not for one party only; but God is only one.
verses.textEn: A mediator, however, implies more than one party; but God is one.

verses.textZh: 这样，律法和神的应许是对立的吗？绝对不是。如果所赐下的律法能使人得生命，义就真的是出于律法了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，律法和神的应许是对立的吗？绝对不是。如果所赐下的律法能使人得生命，义就真的是出于律法了。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，律法是与神的应许反对吗？断乎不是！若曾传一个能叫人得生的律法，义就诚然本乎律法了。
verses.textEnNiv: Is the law, therefore, opposed to the promises of God? Absolutely not! For if a law had been given that could impart life, then righteousness would certainly have come by the law.
verses.textEnEsv: Is the law then contrary to the promises of God? Certainly not! For if a law had been given that could give life, then righteousness would indeed be by the law.
verses.textEnNkjv: Is the law then against the promises of God? Certainly not! For if there had been a law given which could have given life, truly righteousness would have been by the law.
verses.textEnNlt: Is there a conflict, then, between God’s law and God’s promises? Absolutely not! If the law could give us new life, we could be made right with God by obeying it.
verses.textEnNasb: Is the Law then contrary to the promises of God? Far from it! For if a law had been given that was able to impart life, then righteousness would indeed have been based on law.
verses.textEn: Is the law, therefore, opposed to the promises of God? Absolutely not! For if a law had been given that could impart life, then righteousness would certainly have come by the law.

verses.textZh: 但圣经把所有的人都圈在罪中，好把那因信耶稣基督而来的应许，赐给相信的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但圣经把所有的人都圈在罪中，好把那因信耶稣基督而来的应许，赐给相信的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 但圣经把众人都圈在罪里，使所应许的福因信耶稣基督，归给那信的人。
verses.textEnNiv: But Scripture has locked up everything under the control of sin, so that what was promised, being given through faith in Jesus Christ, might be given to those who believe.
verses.textEnEsv: But the Scripture imprisoned everything under sin, so that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Scripture has confined all under sin, that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Scriptures declare that we are all prisoners of sin, so we receive God’s promise of freedom only by believing in Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: But the Scripture has confined everyone under sin, so that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.
verses.textEn: But Scripture has locked up everything under the control of sin, so that what was promised, being given through faith in Jesus Christ, might be given to those who believe.

verses.textZh: 但信的道理还没有来到以前，我们在律法下被囚禁、被围困，直到那要来的信的道理显明出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但信的道理还没有来到以前，我们在律法下被囚禁、被围困，直到那要来的信的道理显明出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 但这因信得救的理还未来以先，我们被看守在律法之下，直圈到那将来的真道显明出来。
verses.textEnNiv: Before the coming of this faith, we were held in custody under the law, locked up until the faith that was to come would be revealed.
verses.textEnEsv: Now before faith came, we were held captive under the law, imprisoned until the coming faith would be revealed.
verses.textEnNkjv: But before faith came, we were kept under guard by the law, kept for the faith which would afterward be revealed.
verses.textEnNlt: Before the way of faith in Christ was available to us, we were placed under guard by the law. We were kept in protective custody, so to speak, until the way of faith was revealed.
verses.textEnNasb: But before faith came, we were kept in custody under the Law, being confined for the faith that was destined to be revealed.
verses.textEn: Before the coming of this faith, we were held in custody under the law, locked up until the faith that was to come would be revealed.

verses.textZh: 这样，律法成了我们的启蒙教师，领我们到基督那里，使我们可以因信称义。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，律法成了我们的启蒙教师，领我们到基督那里，使我们可以因信称义。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，律法是我们训蒙的师傅，引我们到基督那里，使我们因信称义。
verses.textEnNiv: So the law was our guardian until Christ came that we might be justified by faith.
verses.textEnEsv: So then, the law was our guardian until Christ came, in order that we might be justified by faith.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the law was our tutor tobringus to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
verses.textEnNlt: Let me put it another way. The law was our guardian until Christ came; it protected us until we could be made right with God through faith.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore the Law has become our guardian to lead us to Christ, so that we may be justified by faith.
verses.textEn: So the law was our guardian until Christ came that we might be justified by faith.

verses.textZh: 但信的道理既然来到，我们就不再在启蒙教师之下了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但信的道理既然来到，我们就不再在启蒙教师之下了。
verses.textZhCuv: 但这因信得救的理既然来到，我们从此就不在师傅的手下了。
verses.textEnNiv: Now that this faith has come, we are no longer under a guardian.
verses.textEnEsv: But now that faith has come, we are no longer under a guardian,
verses.textEnNkjv: But after faith has come, we are no longer under a tutor.
verses.textEnNlt: And now that the way of faith has come, we no longer need the law as our guardian.
verses.textEnNasb: But now that faith has come, we are no longer under a guardian.
verses.textEn: Now that this faith has come, we are no longer under a guardian.

verses.textZh: 你们因着信，在基督耶稣里都作了神的儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们因着信，在基督耶稣里都作了神的儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，你们因信基督耶稣都是神的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: So in Christ Jesus you are all children of God through faith,
verses.textEnEsv: for in Christ Jesus you are all sons of God, through faith.
verses.textEnNkjv: For you are all sons of God through faith in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNlt: For you are all children of God through faith in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: For you are all sons and daughters of God through faith in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEn: So in Christ Jesus you are all children of God through faith,

verses.textZh: 你们所有受洗归入基督的人，都是披戴基督的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们所有受洗归入基督的人，都是披戴基督的，
verses.textZhCuv: 你们受洗归入基督的都是披戴基督了。
verses.textEnNiv: for all of you who were baptized into Christ have clothed yourselves with Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: For as many of you as were baptized into Christ have put on Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: For as many of you as were baptized into Christ have put on Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: And all who have been united with Christ in baptism have put on Christ, like putting on new clothes.
verses.textEnNasb: For all of you who were baptized into Christ have clothed yourselves with Christ.
verses.textEn: for all of you who were baptized into Christ have clothed yourselves with Christ.

verses.textZh: 并不分犹太人或希腊人，作奴仆的或自由人，男的或女的，因为你们在基督耶稣里都成为一体了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 并不分犹太人或希腊人，作奴仆的或自由人，男的或女的，因为你们在基督耶稣里都成为一体了。
verses.textZhCuv: 并不分犹太人、希腊人，自主的、为奴的，或男或女，因为你们在基督耶稣里都成为一了。
verses.textEnNiv: There is neither Jew nor Gentile, neither slave nor free, nor is there male and female, for you are all one in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free, there is no male and female, for you are all one in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free, there is neither male nor female; for you are all one in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNlt: There is no longer Jew or Gentile, slave or free, male and female. For you are all one in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free, there is neither male nor female; for you are all one in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEn: There is neither Jew nor Gentile, neither slave nor free, nor is there male and female, for you are all one in Christ Jesus.

verses.textZh: 如果你们属于基督，就是亚伯拉罕的后裔，是按照应许承受产业的了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你们属于基督，就是亚伯拉罕的后裔，是按照应许承受产业的了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们既属乎基督，就是亚伯拉罕的后裔，是照着应许承受产业的了。
verses.textEnNiv: If you belong to Christ, then you are Abraham’s seed, and heirs according to the promise.
verses.textEnEsv: And if you are Christ’s, then you are Abraham’s offspring, heirs according to promise.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if you are Christ’s, then you are Abraham’s seed, and heirs according to the promise.
verses.textEnNlt: And now that you belong to Christ, you are the true children of Abraham. You are his heirs, and God’s promise to Abraham belongs to you.
verses.textEnNasb: And if you belong to Christ, then you are Abraham’s descendants, heirs according to promise.
verses.textEn: If you belong to Christ, then you are Abraham’s seed, and heirs according to the promise.

verses.textZh: 我说，那承受产业的，虽然是全部产业的主人，但在孩童的时期，却和奴仆没有分别。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我说，那承受产业的，虽然是全部产业的主人，但在孩童的时期，却和奴仆没有分别。
verses.textZhCuv: 我说那承受产业的，虽然是全业的主人，但为孩童的时候却与奴仆毫无分别，
verses.textEnNiv: What I am saying is that as long as an heir is underage, he is no different from a slave, although he owns the whole estate.
verses.textEnEsv: I mean that the heir, as long as he is a child, is no different from a slave, though he is the owner of everything,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now I say that the heir, as long as he is a child, does not differ at all from a slave, though he is master of all,
verses.textEnNlt: Think of it this way. If a father dies and leaves an inheritance for his young children, those children are not much better off than slaves until they grow up, even though they actually own everything their father had.
verses.textEnNasb: Now I say, as long as the heir is a child, he does not differ at all from a slave, although he is owner of everything,
verses.textEn: What I am saying is that as long as an heir is underage, he is no different from a slave, although he owns the whole estate.

verses.textZh: 他是在监护人和管家之下，直到父亲预先指定的时候。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他是在监护人和管家之下，直到父亲预先指定的时候。
verses.textZhCuv: 乃在师傅和管家的手下，直等他父亲预定的时候来到。
verses.textEnNiv: The heir is subject to guardians and trustees until the time set by his father.
verses.textEnEsv: but he is under guardians and managers until the date set by his father.
verses.textEnNkjv: but is under guardians and stewards until the time appointed by the father.
verses.textEnNlt: They have to obey their guardians until they reach whatever age their father set.
verses.textEnNasb: but he is under guardians and managers until the date set by the father.
verses.textEn: The heir is subject to guardians and trustees until the time set by his father.

verses.textZh: 我们也是这样，作孩童的时候，被世俗的言论所奴役；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们也是这样，作孩童的时候，被世俗的言论所奴役；
verses.textZhCuv: 我们为孩童的时候，受管于世俗小学之下，也是如此。
verses.textEnNiv: So also, when we were underage, we were in slavery under the elemental spiritual forces of the world.
verses.textEnEsv: In the same way we also, when we were children, were enslaved to the elementary principles of the world.
verses.textEnNkjv: Even so we, when we were children, were in bondage under the elements of the world.
verses.textEnNlt: And that’s the way it was with us before Christ came. We were like children; we were slaves to the basic spiritual principles of this world.
verses.textEnNasb: So we too, when we were children, were held in bondage under the elementary principles of the world.
verses.textEn: So also, when we were underage, we were in slavery under the elemental spiritual forces of the world.

verses.textZh: 但到了时机成熟，神就差遣他的儿子，由女人所生，而且生在律法之下，
verses.textZhCnvs: 但到了时机成熟，神就差遣他的儿子，由女人所生，而且生在律法之下，
verses.textZhCuv: 及至时候满足，神就差遣他的儿子，为女子所生，且生在律法以下，
verses.textEnNiv: But when the set time had fully come, God sent his Son, born of a woman, born under the law,
verses.textEnEsv: But when the fullness of time had come, God sent forth his Son, born of woman, born under the law,
verses.textEnNkjv: But when the fullness of the time had come, God sent forth His Son, born of a woman, born under the law,
verses.textEnNlt: But when the right time came, God sent his Son, born of a woman, subject to the law.
verses.textEnNasb: But when the fullness of the time came, God sent His Son, born of a woman, born under the Law,
verses.textEn: But when the set time had fully come, God sent his Son, born of a woman, born under the law,

verses.textZh: 要把律法之下的人救赎出来，好让我们得着嗣子的名分。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要把律法之下的人救赎出来，好让我们得着嗣子的名分。
verses.textZhCuv: 要把律法以下的人赎出来，叫我们得着儿子的名分。
verses.textEnNiv: to redeem those under the law, that we might receive adoption to sonship.
verses.textEnEsv: to redeem those who were under the law, so that we might receive adoption as sons.
verses.textEnNkjv: to redeem those who were under the law, that we might receive the adoption as sons.
verses.textEnNlt: God sent him to buy freedom for us who were slaves to the law, so that he could adopt us as his very own children.
verses.textEnNasb: so that He might redeem those who were under the Law, that we might receive the adoption as sons and daughters.
verses.textEn: to redeem those under the law, that we might receive adoption to sonship.

verses.textZh: 你们既然是儿子，神就差遣他儿子的灵进入我们心里，呼叫"阿爸、父！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们既然是儿子，神就差遣他儿子的灵进入我们心里，呼叫"阿爸、父！"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们既为儿子，神就差他儿子的灵进入你们 的心，呼叫：「阿爸！父！」
verses.textEnNiv: Because you are his sons, God sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts, the Spirit who calls out, "Abba, Father."
verses.textEnEsv: And because you are sons, God has sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts, crying, "Abba! Father!"
verses.textEnNkjv: And because you are sons, God has sent forth the Spirit of His Son into your hearts, crying out, "Abba, Father!"
verses.textEnNlt: And because we are his children, God has sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts, prompting us to call out, "Abba, Father."
