verses.textEnNasb: Because you are sons, God has sent the Spirit of His Son into our hearts, crying out, "Abba! Father!"
verses.textEn: Because you are his sons, God sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts, the Spirit who calls out, "Abba, Father."

verses.textZh: 这样，你不再是奴仆，而是儿子；既然是儿子，就靠着神承受产业了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，你不再是奴仆，而是儿子；既然是儿子，就靠着神承受产业了。
verses.textZhCuv: 可见，从此以后，你不是奴仆，乃是儿子了；既是儿子，就靠着神为后嗣。
verses.textEnNiv: So you are no longer a slave, but God’s child; and since you are his child, God has made you also an heir.
verses.textEnEsv: So you are no longer a slave, but a son, and if a son, then an heir through God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore you are no longer a slave but a son, and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: Now you are no longer a slave but God’s own child. And since you are his child, God has made you his heir.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore you are no longer a slave, but a son; and if a son, then an heir through God.
verses.textEn: So you are no longer a slave, but God’s child; and since you are his child, God has made you also an heir.

verses.textZh: 从前你们不认识神的时候，是给那些本来不是神的作奴仆；
verses.textZhCnvs: 从前你们不认识神的时候，是给那些本来不是神的作奴仆；
verses.textZhCuv: 但从前你们不认识神的时候，是给那些本来不是神的作奴仆；
verses.textEnNiv: Formerly, when you did not know God, you were slaves to those who by nature are not gods.
verses.textEnEsv: Formerly, when you did not know God, you were enslaved to those that by nature are not gods.
verses.textEnNkjv: But then, indeed, when you did not know God, you served those which by nature are not gods.
verses.textEnNlt: Before you Gentiles knew God, you were slaves to so-called gods that do not even exist.
verses.textEnNasb: However at that time, when you did not know God, you were slaves to those which by nature are not gods.
verses.textEn: Formerly, when you did not know God, you were slaves to those who by nature are not gods.

verses.textZh: 现在你们既然认识神，更可以说是神所认识的，怎么还回到那些软弱贫乏的言论，情愿再作它们的奴仆呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你们既然认识神，更可以说是神所认识的，怎么还回到那些软弱贫乏的言论，情愿再作它们的奴仆呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你们既然认识神，更可说是被神所认识的，怎么还要归回那懦弱无用的小学，情愿再给他作奴仆呢？
verses.textEnNiv: But now that you know God—or rather are known by God—how is it that you are turning back to those weak and miserable forces ? Do you wish to be enslaved by them all over again?
verses.textEnEsv: But now that you have come to know God, or rather to be known by God, how can you turn back again to the weak and worthless elementary principles of the world, whose slaves you want to be once more?
verses.textEnNkjv: But now after you have known God, or rather are known by God, how isitthat you turn again to the weak and beggarly elements, to which you desire again to be in bondage?
verses.textEnNlt: So now that you know God (or should I say, now that God knows you), why do you want to go back again and become slaves once more to the weak and useless spiritual principles of this world?
verses.textEnNasb: But now that you have come to know God, or rather to be known by God, how is it that you turn back again to the weak and worthless elementary principles, to which you want to be enslaved all over again?
verses.textEn: But now that you know God—or rather are known by God—how is it that you are turning back to those weak and miserable forces ? Do you wish to be enslaved by them all over again?

verses.textZh: 你们严守日子、月份、节期、年份；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们严守日子、月份、节期、年份；
verses.textZhCuv: 你们谨守日子、月份、节期、年份，
verses.textEnNiv: You are observing special days and months and seasons and years!
verses.textEnEsv: You observe days and months and seasons and years!
verses.textEnNkjv: You observe days and months and seasons and years.
verses.textEnNlt: You are trying to earn favor with God by observing certain days or months or seasons or years.
verses.textEnNasb: You meticulously observe days and months and seasons and years.
verses.textEn: You are observing special days and months and seasons and years!

verses.textZh: 我为你们担心，恐怕我在你们身上的劳苦是白费了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我为你们担心，恐怕我在你们身上的劳苦是白费了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我为你们害怕，惟恐我在你们身上是枉费了工夫。
verses.textEnNiv: I fear for you, that somehow I have wasted my efforts on you.
verses.textEnEsv: I am afraid I may have labored over you in vain.
verses.textEnNkjv: I am afraid for you, lest I have labored for you in vain.
verses.textEnNlt: I fear for you. Perhaps all my hard work with you was for nothing.
verses.textEnNasb: I fear for you, that perhaps I have labored over you in vain.
verses.textEn: I fear for you, that somehow I have wasted my efforts on you.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，我请求你们要像我一样，因为我也像你们一样。你们并没有亏负过我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，我请求你们要像我一样，因为我也像你们一样。你们并没有亏负过我。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，我劝你们要像我一样，因为我也像你们一样。你们一点没有亏负我。
verses.textEnNiv: I plead with you, brothers and sisters, become like me, for I became like you. You did me no wrong.
verses.textEnEsv: Brothers, I entreat you, become as I am, for I also have become as you are. You did me no wrong.
verses.textEnNkjv: Brethren, I urge you to become like me, for I became like you. You have not injured me at all.
verses.textEnNlt: Dear brothers and sisters, I plead with you to live as I do in freedom from these things, for I have become like you Gentiles—free from those laws. You did not mistreat me when I first preached to you.
verses.textEnNasb: I beg of you, brothers and sisters, become as I am, for I also have become as you are. You have done me no wrong;
verses.textEn: I plead with you, brothers and sisters, become like me, for I became like you. You did me no wrong.

verses.textZh: 你们知道，我第一次传福音给你们，是因为身体有病。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们知道，我第一次传福音给你们，是因为身体有病。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们知道我头一次传福音给你们，是因为身体有疾病。
verses.textEnNiv: As you know, it was because of an illness that I first preached the gospel to you,
verses.textEnEsv: You know it was because of a bodily ailment that I preached the gospel to you at first,
verses.textEnNkjv: You know that because of physical infirmity I preached the gospel to you at the first.
verses.textEnNlt: Surely you remember that I was sick when I first brought you the Good News.
verses.textEnNasb: but you know that it was because of a bodily illness that I preached the gospel to you the first time;
verses.textEn: As you know, it was because of an illness that I first preached the gospel to you,

verses.textZh: 虽然我的身体对你们是个试炼，你们却没有轻看，也没有厌弃，反而接纳我，好象神的天使，也好象基督耶稣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然我的身体对你们是个试炼，你们却没有轻看，也没有厌弃，反而接纳我，好象神的天使，也好象基督耶稣。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们为我身体的缘故受试炼，没有轻看我，也没有厌弃我，反倒接待我，如同神的使者，如同基督耶稣。
verses.textEnNiv: and even though my illness was a trial to you, you did not treat me with contempt or scorn. Instead, you welcomed me as if I were an angel of God, as if I were Christ Jesus himself.
verses.textEnEsv: and though my condition was a trial to you, you did not scorn or despise me, but received me as an angel of God, as Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: And my trial which was in my flesh you did not despise or reject, but you received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNlt: But even though my condition tempted you to reject me, you did not despise me or turn me away. No, you took me in and cared for me as though I were an angel from God or even Christ Jesus himself.
verses.textEnNasb: and you did not despise that which was a trial to you in my bodily condition, nor express contempt, but you received me as an angel of God, as Christ Jesus Himself.
verses.textEn: and even though my illness was a trial to you, you did not treat me with contempt or scorn. Instead, you welcomed me as if I were an angel of God, as if I were Christ Jesus himself.

verses.textZh: 现在，你们的欢乐在哪里呢？我可以为你们作证，那时如果可能，你们甚至愿意把你们的眼睛剜出来给我哩！
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在，你们的欢乐在哪里呢？我可以为你们作证，那时如果可能，你们甚至愿意把你们的眼睛剜出来给我哩！
verses.textZhCuv: 你们当日所夸的福气在哪里呢？那时你们若能行，就是把自己的眼睛剜出来给我，也都情愿。这是我可以给你们作见证的。
verses.textEnNiv: Where, then, is your blessing of me now? I can testify that, if you could have done so, you would have torn out your eyes and given them to me.
verses.textEnEsv: What then has become of your blessedness? For I testify to you that, if possible, you would have gouged out your eyes and given them to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: What then was the blessing you enjoyed? For I bear you witness that, if possible, you would have plucked out your own eyes and given them to me.
verses.textEnNlt: Where is that joyful and grateful spirit you felt then? I am sure you would have taken out your own eyes and given them to me if it had been possible.
verses.textEnNasb: Where then is that sense of blessing you had? For I testify about you that, if possible, you would have torn out your eyes and given them to me.
verses.textEn: Where, then, is your blessing of me now? I can testify that, if you could have done so, you would have torn out your eyes and given them to me.

verses.textZh: 现在我把真理告诉你们，反而成了你们的仇敌吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在我把真理告诉你们，反而成了你们的仇敌吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 如今我将真理告诉你们，就成了你们的仇敌吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Have I now become your enemy by telling you the truth?
verses.textEnEsv: Have I then become your enemy by telling you the truth?
verses.textEnNkjv: Have I therefore become your enemy because I tell you the truth?
verses.textEnNlt: Have I now become your enemy because I am telling you the truth?
verses.textEnNasb: So have I become your enemy by telling you the truth?
verses.textEn: Have I now become your enemy by telling you the truth?

verses.textZh: 那些人热心待你们，并不是出于好意，而是想你们和我疏远，好使你们热心待他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些人热心待你们，并不是出于好意，而是想你们和我疏远，好使你们热心待他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 那些人热心待你们，却不是好意，是要离间你们 ，叫你们热心待他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Those people are zealous to win you over, but for no good. What they want is to alienate you from us, so that you may have zeal for them.
verses.textEnEsv: They make much of you, but for no good purpose. They want to shut you out, that you may make much of them.
verses.textEnNkjv: They zealously court you, but for no good; yes, they want to exclude you, that you may be zealous for them.
verses.textEnNlt: Those false teachers are so eager to win your favor, but their intentions are not good. They are trying to shut you off from me so that you will pay attention only to them.
verses.textEnNasb: They eagerly seek you, not in a commendable way, but they want to shut you out so that you will seek them.
verses.textEn: Those people are zealous to win you over, but for no good. What they want is to alienate you from us, so that you may have zeal for them.

verses.textZh: 常常在善事上热心，总是好的；只是不要我在你们那里的时候才是这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 常常在善事上热心，总是好的；只是不要我在你们那里的时候才是这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 在善事上，常用热心待人原是好的，却不单我与你们同在的时候才这样。
verses.textEnNiv: It is fine to be zealous, provided the purpose is good, and to be so always, not just when I am with you.
verses.textEnEsv: It is always good to be made much of for a good purpose, and not only when I am present with you,
verses.textEnNkjv: But it is good to be zealous in a good thing always, and not only when I am present with you.
verses.textEnNlt: If someone is eager to do good things for you, that’s all right; but let them do it all the time, not just when I’m with you.
verses.textEnNasb: But it is good always to be eagerly sought in a commendable way, and not only when I am present with you.
verses.textEn: It is fine to be zealous, provided the purpose is good, and to be so always, not just when I am with you.

verses.textZh: 我的孩子们，为了你们我再受生产的痛苦，直到基督在你们里面成形。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的孩子们，为了你们我再受生产的痛苦，直到基督在你们里面成形。
verses.textZhCuv: 我小子啊，我为你们再受生产之苦，直等到基督成形在你们心里。
verses.textEnNiv: My dear children, for whom I am again in the pains of childbirth until Christ is formed in you,
verses.textEnEsv: my little children, for whom I am again in the anguish of childbirth until Christ is formed in you!
verses.textEnNkjv: My little children, for whom I labor in birth again until Christ is formed in you,
verses.textEnNlt: Oh, my dear children! I feel as if I’m going through labor pains for you again, and they will continue until Christ is fully developed in your lives.
verses.textEnNasb: My children, with whom I am again in labor until Christ is formed in you—
verses.textEn: My dear children, for whom I am again in the pains of childbirth until Christ is formed in you,

verses.textZh: 我恨不得现今就在你们那里，改变我的语气，因为我为你们十分困扰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我恨不得现今就在你们那里，改变我的语气，因为我为你们十分困扰。
verses.textZhCuv: 我巴不得现今在你们那里，改换口气，因我为你们心里作难。
verses.textEnNiv: how I wish I could be with you now and change my tone, because I am perplexed about you!
verses.textEnEsv: I wish I could be present with you now and change my tone, for I am perplexed about you.
verses.textEnNkjv: I would like to be present with you now and to change my tone; for I have doubts about you.
verses.textEnNlt: I wish I were with you right now so I could change my tone. But at this distance I don’t know how else to help you.
verses.textEnNasb: but I could wish to be present with you now and to change my tone of voice, for I am at a loss about you!
verses.textEn: how I wish I could be with you now and change my tone, because I am perplexed about you!

verses.textZh: 你们这愿意在律法之下的人哪！请告诉我，你们没有听过律法吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们这愿意在律法之下的人哪！请告诉我，你们没有听过律法吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们这愿意在律法以下的人，请告诉我，你们岂没有听见律法吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Tell me, you who want to be under the law, are you not aware of what the law says?
verses.textEnEsv: Tell me, you who desire to be under the law, do you not listen to the law?
verses.textEnNkjv: Tell me, you who desire to be under the law, do you not hear the law?
verses.textEnNlt: Tell me, you who want to live under the law, do you know what the law actually says?
verses.textEnNasb: Tell me, you who want to be under law, do you not listen to the Law?
verses.textEn: Tell me, you who want to be under the law, are you not aware of what the law says?

verses.textZh: 经上记着说，亚伯拉罕有两个儿子，一个出于婢女，一个出于自由的妇人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 经上记着说，亚伯拉罕有两个儿子，一个出于婢女，一个出于自由的妇人。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为律法上记着，亚伯拉罕有两个儿子，一个是使女生的，一个是自主之妇人生的。
verses.textEnNiv: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the slave woman and the other by the free woman.
verses.textEnEsv: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by a slave woman and one by a free woman.
verses.textEnNkjv: For it is written that Abraham had two sons: the one by a bondwoman, the other by a freewoman.
verses.textEnNlt: The Scriptures say that Abraham had two sons, one from his slave wife and one from his freeborn wife.
verses.textEnNasb: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the slave woman and one by the free woman.
verses.textEn: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the slave woman and the other by the free woman.

verses.textZh: 但那出于婢女的，是按着肉体生的；那出于自由的妇人的，是凭着应许生的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但那出于婢女的，是按着肉体生的；那出于自由的妇人的，是凭着应许生的。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，那使女所生的是按着血气生的；那自主之妇人所生的是凭着应许生的。
verses.textEnNiv: His son by the slave woman was born according to the flesh, but his son by the free woman was born as the result of a divine promise.
verses.textEnEsv: But the son of the slave was born according to the flesh, while the son of the free woman was born through promise.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he whowas of the bondwoman was born according to the flesh, and he of the freewoman through promise,
verses.textEnNlt: The son of the slave wife was born in a human attempt to bring about the fulfillment of God’s promise. But the son of the freeborn wife was born as God’s own fulfillment of his promise.
verses.textEnNasb: But the son by the slave woman was born according to the flesh, and the son by the free woman through the promise.
verses.textEn: His son by the slave woman was born according to the flesh, but his son by the free woman was born as the result of a divine promise.

verses.textZh: 这都是寓意的说法：那两个妇人就是两个约，一个是出于西奈山，生子作奴仆，这是夏甲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这都是寓意的说法：那两个妇人就是两个约，一个是出于西奈山，生子作奴仆，这是夏甲。
verses.textZhCuv: 这都是比方：那两个妇人就是两约。一约是出于西奈山，生子为奴，乃是夏甲。
verses.textEnNiv: These things are being taken figuratively: The women represent two covenants. One covenant is from Mount Sinai and bears children who are to be slaves: This is Hagar.
verses.textEnEsv: Now this may be interpreted allegorically: these women are two covenants. One is from Mount Sinai, bearing children for slavery; she is Hagar.
verses.textEnNkjv: which things are symbolic. For these are the two covenants: the one from Mount Sinai which gives birth to bondage, which is Hagar—
verses.textEnNlt: These two women serve as an illustration of God’s two covenants. The first woman, Hagar, represents Mount Sinai where people received the law that enslaved them.
verses.textEnNasb: This is speaking allegorically, for these women are two covenants: one coming from Mount Sinai giving birth to children who are to be slaves; she is Hagar.
verses.textEn: These things are being taken figuratively: The women represent two covenants. One covenant is from Mount Sinai and bears children who are to be slaves: This is Hagar.

verses.textZh: 这夏甲是指着阿拉伯的西奈山，相当于现在的耶路撒冷，她和她的儿女都是作奴仆的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这夏甲是指着阿拉伯的西奈山，相当于现在的耶路撒冷，她和她的儿女都是作奴仆的。
verses.textZhCuv: 这夏甲二字是指着阿拉伯的西奈山，与现在的耶路撒冷同类，因耶路撒冷和她的儿女都是为奴的。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Hagar stands for Mount Sinai in Arabia and corresponds to the present city of Jerusalem, because she is in slavery with her children.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia; she corresponds to the present Jerusalem, for she is in slavery with her children.
verses.textEnNkjv: for this Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia, and corresponds to Jerusalem which now is, and is in bondage with her children—
verses.textEnNlt: And now Jerusalem is just like Mount Sinai in Arabia, because she and her children live in slavery to the law.
verses.textEnNasb: Now this Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia and corresponds to the present Jerusalem, for she is enslaved with her children.
verses.textEn: Now Hagar stands for Mount Sinai in Arabia and corresponds to the present city of Jerusalem, because she is in slavery with her children.

verses.textZh: 那在上面的耶路撒冷是自由的，她是我们的母亲，
verses.textZhCnvs: 那在上面的耶路撒冷是自由的，她是我们的母亲，
verses.textZhCuv: 但那在上的耶路撒冷是自主的，她是我们的母。
verses.textEnNiv: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, and she is our mother.
verses.textEnEsv: But the Jerusalem above is free, and she is our mother.
verses.textEnNkjv: but the Jerusalem above is free, which is the mother of us all.
verses.textEnNlt: But the other woman, Sarah, represents the heavenly Jerusalem. She is the free woman, and she is our mother.
verses.textEnNasb: But the Jerusalem above is free; she is our mother.
verses.textEn: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, and she is our mother.

verses.textZh: 因为经上记着说： "不能生育、没有生养的啊，你要欢欣！ 没有受过生产痛苦的啊，你要呼喊，大声呼叫！ 因为弃妇比有夫之妇有更多儿子。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为经上记着说： "不能生育、没有生养的啊，你要欢欣！ 没有受过生产痛苦的啊，你要呼喊，大声呼叫！ 因为弃妇比有夫之妇有更多儿子。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为经上记着： 不怀孕、不生养的，你要欢乐； 未曾经过产难的，你要高声欢呼； 因为没有丈夫的，比有丈夫的儿女更多。
verses.textEnNiv: For it is written: "Be glad, barren woman, you who never bore a child; shout for joy and cry aloud, you who were never in labor; because more are the children of the desolate woman than of her who has a husband."
verses.textEnEsv: For it is written, "Rejoice, O barren one who does not bear; break forth and cry aloud, you who are not in labor! For the children of the desolate one will be more than those of the one who has a husband."
verses.textEnNkjv: For it is written: "Rejoice, O barren, You who do not bear! Break forth and shout, You who are not in labor! For the desolate has many more children Than she who has a husband."
verses.textEnNlt: As Isaiah said, "Rejoice, O childless woman, you who have never given birth! Break into a joyful shout, you who have never been in labor! For the desolate woman now has more children than the woman who lives with her husband!"
verses.textEnNasb: For it is written: "Rejoice, infertile one, you who do not give birth; Break forth and shout, you who are not in labor; For the children of the desolate one are more numerous Than those of the one who has a husband."
verses.textEn: For it is written: "Be glad, barren woman, you who never bore a child; shout for joy and cry aloud, you who were never in labor; because more are the children of the desolate woman than of her who has a husband."

verses.textZh: 可是，弟兄们，你们是按着应许作儿女的，好象以撒一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是，弟兄们，你们是按着应许作儿女的，好象以撒一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，我们是凭着应许作儿女，如同以撒一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Now you, brothers and sisters, like Isaac, are children of promise.
verses.textEnEsv: Now you, brothers, like Isaac, are children of promise.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now we, brethren, as Isaac was, are children of promise.
verses.textEnNlt: And you, dear brothers and sisters, are children of the promise, just like Isaac.
verses.textEnNasb: And you, brothers and sisters, like Isaac, are children of promise.
verses.textEn: Now you, brothers and sisters, like Isaac, are children of promise.

verses.textZh: 不过，当时那按着肉体生的，迫害那按着圣灵生的，现在也是这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不过，当时那按着肉体生的，迫害那按着圣灵生的，现在也是这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 当时，那按着血气生的逼迫了那按着圣灵生的，现在也是这样。
verses.textEnNiv: At that time the son born according to the flesh persecuted the son born by the power of the Spirit. It is the same now.
verses.textEnEsv: But just as at that time he who was born according to the flesh persecuted him who was born according to the Spirit, so also it is now.
verses.textEnNkjv: But, as he who was born according to the flesh then persecuted him whowasborn according to the Spirit, even so itis now.
verses.textEnNlt: But you are now being persecuted by those who want you to keep the law, just as Ishmael, the child born by human effort, persecuted Isaac, the child born by the power of the Spirit.
verses.textEnNasb: But as at that time the son who was born according to the flesh persecuted the one who was born according to the Spirit, so it is even now.
verses.textEn: At that time the son born according to the flesh persecuted the son born by the power of the Spirit. It is the same now.

verses.textZh: 然而经上怎样说呢？"把婢女和她的儿子赶出去，因为婢女的儿子，绝对不可以和自由的妇人的儿子一同承受产业。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而经上怎样说呢？"把婢女和她的儿子赶出去，因为婢女的儿子，绝对不可以和自由的妇人的儿子一同承受产业。"
verses.textZhCuv: 然而经上是怎么说的呢？是说：「把使女和她儿子赶出去！因为使女的儿子不可与自主妇人的儿子一同承受产业。」
verses.textEnNiv: But what does Scripture say? "Get rid of the slave woman and her son, for the slave woman’s son will never share in the inheritance with the free woman’s son."
verses.textEnEsv: But what does the Scripture say? "Cast out the slave woman and her son, for the son of the slave woman shall not inherit with the son of the free woman."
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless what does the Scripture say? "Cast out the bondwoman and her son, for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with the son of the freewoman."
verses.textEnNlt: But what do the Scriptures say about that? "Get rid of the slave and her son, for the son of the slave woman will not share the inheritance with the free woman’s son."
verses.textEnNasb: But what does the Scripture say? "Drive out the slave woman and her son, For the son of the slave woman shall not be an heir with the son of the free woman."
verses.textEn: But what does Scripture say? "Get rid of the slave woman and her son, for the slave woman’s son will never share in the inheritance with the free woman’s son."

verses.textZh: 所以，弟兄们，我们不是婢女的儿女，而是自由的妇人的儿女了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，弟兄们，我们不是婢女的儿女，而是自由的妇人的儿女了。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，这样看来，我们不是使女的儿女，乃是自主妇人的儿女了。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, brothers and sisters, we are not children of the slave woman, but of the free woman.
verses.textEnEsv: So, brothers, we are not children of the slave but of the free woman.
verses.textEnNkjv: So then, brethren, we are not children of the bondwoman but of the free.
verses.textEnNlt: So, dear brothers and sisters, we are not children of the slave woman; we are children of the free woman.
verses.textEnNasb: So then, brothers and sisters, we are not children of a slave woman, but of the free woman.
verses.textEn: Therefore, brothers and sisters, we are not children of the slave woman, but of the free woman.

verses.textZh: 基督释放了我们，为了要使我们得自由。所以你们要站立得稳，不要再被奴役的轭控制。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基督释放了我们，为了要使我们得自由。所以你们要站立得稳，不要再被奴役的轭控制。
verses.textZhCuv: 基督释放了我们，叫我们得以自由。所以要站立得稳，不要再被奴仆的轭挟制。
verses.textEnNiv: It is for freedom that Christ has set us free. Stand firm, then, and do not let yourselves be burdened again by a yoke of slavery.
verses.textEnEsv: For freedom Christ has set us free; stand firm therefore, and do not submit again to a yoke of slavery.
verses.textEnNkjv: Stand fast therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and do not be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.
verses.textEnNlt: So Christ has truly set us free. Now make sure that you stay free, and don’t get tied up again in slavery to the law.
verses.textEnNasb: It was for freedom that Christ set us free; therefore keep standing firm and do not be subject again to a yoke of slavery.
verses.textEn: It is for freedom that Christ has set us free. Stand firm, then, and do not let yourselves be burdened again by a yoke of slavery.

verses.textZh: 我保罗现在告诉你们，如果你们受割礼，基督对你们就毫无益处了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我保罗现在告诉你们，如果你们受割礼，基督对你们就毫无益处了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我－保罗告诉你们，若受割礼，基督就与你们无益了。
verses.textEnNiv: Mark my words! I, Paul, tell you that if you let yourselves be circumcised, Christ will be of no value to you at all.
verses.textEnEsv: Look: I, Paul, say to you that if you accept circumcision, Christ will be of no advantage to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed I, Paul, say to you that if you become circumcised, Christ will profit you nothing.
verses.textEnNlt: Listen! I, Paul, tell you this: If you are counting on circumcision to make you right with God, then Christ will be of no benefit to you.
verses.textEnNasb: Look! I, Paul, tell you that if you have yourselves circumcised, Christ will be of no benefit to you.
verses.textEn: Mark my words! I, Paul, tell you that if you let yourselves be circumcised, Christ will be of no value to you at all.

verses.textZh: 我再对所有受割礼的人郑重声明：他有责任遵行全部的律法。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我再对所有受割礼的人郑重声明：他有责任遵行全部的律法。
verses.textZhCuv: 我再指着凡受割礼的人确实地说，他是欠着行全律法的债。
verses.textEnNiv: Again I declare to every man who lets himself be circumcised that he is obligated to obey the whole law.
verses.textEnEsv: I testify again to every man who accepts circumcision that he is obligated to keep the whole law.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I testify again to every man who becomes circumcised that he is a debtor to keep the whole law.
verses.textEnNlt: I’ll say it again. If you are trying to find favor with God by being circumcised, you must obey every regulation in the whole law of Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: And I testify again to every man who has himself circumcised, that he is obligated to keep the whole Law.
verses.textEn: Again I declare to every man who lets himself be circumcised that he is obligated to obey the whole law.

verses.textZh: 你们这些靠律法称义的人，是和基督隔绝，从恩典中坠落了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们这些靠律法称义的人，是和基督隔绝，从恩典中坠落了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们这要靠律法称义的，是与基督隔绝，从恩典中坠落了。
verses.textEnNiv: You who are trying to be justified by the law have been alienated from Christ; you have fallen away from grace.
verses.textEnEsv: You are severed from Christ, you who would be justified by the law; you have fallen away from grace.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have become estranged from Christ, you who attemptto be justified by law; you have fallen from grace.
verses.textEnNlt: For if you are trying to make yourselves right with God by keeping the law, you have been cut off from Christ! You have fallen away from God’s grace.
verses.textEnNasb: You have been severed from Christ, you who are seeking to be justified by the Law; you have fallen from grace.
verses.textEn: You who are trying to be justified by the law have been alienated from Christ; you have fallen away from grace.

verses.textZh: 我们靠着圣灵，凭着信，热切等候所盼望的义。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们靠着圣灵，凭着信，热切等候所盼望的义。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们靠着圣灵，凭着信心，等候所盼望的义。
verses.textEnNiv: For through the Spirit we eagerly await by faith the righteousness for which we hope.
verses.textEnEsv: For through the Spirit, by faith, we ourselves eagerly wait for the hope of righteousness.
verses.textEnNkjv: For we through the Spirit eagerly wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.
verses.textEnNlt: But we who live by the Spirit eagerly wait to receive by faith the righteousness God has promised to us.
verses.textEnNasb: For we, through the Spirit, by faith, are waiting for the hope of righteousness.
verses.textEn: For through the Spirit we eagerly await by faith the righteousness for which we hope.

verses.textZh: 因为在基督耶稣里，受割礼或不受割礼，都没有用处，唯有那借着爱表达出来的信，才有用处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为在基督耶稣里，受割礼或不受割礼，都没有用处，唯有那借着爱表达出来的信，才有用处。
verses.textZhCuv: 原来在基督耶稣里，受割礼不受割礼全无功效，惟独使人生发仁爱的信心才有功效。
verses.textEnNiv: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision has any value. The only thing that counts is faith expressing itself through love.
verses.textEnEsv: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision counts for anything, but only faith working through love.
verses.textEnNkjv: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision avails anything, but faith working through love.
verses.textEnNlt: For when we place our faith in Christ Jesus, there is no benefit in being circumcised or being uncircumcised. What is important is faith expressing itself in love.
verses.textEnNasb: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision means anything, but faith working through love.
verses.textEn: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision has any value. The only thing that counts is faith expressing itself through love.

verses.textZh: 你们向来跑得好，谁拦阻了你们，使你们不顺从真理呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们向来跑得好，谁拦阻了你们，使你们不顺从真理呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们向来跑得好，有谁拦阻你们，叫你们不顺从真理呢？
verses.textEnNiv: You were running a good race. Who cut in on you to keep you from obeying the truth?
verses.textEnEsv: You were running well. Who hindered you from obeying the truth?
verses.textEnNkjv: You ran well. Who hindered you from obeying the truth?
verses.textEnNlt: You were running the race so well. Who has held you back from following the truth?
verses.textEnNasb: You were running well; who hindered you from obeying the truth?
verses.textEn: You were running a good race. Who cut in on you to keep you from obeying the truth?

verses.textZh: 这种劝诱不是出于那召你们的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这种劝诱不是出于那召你们的。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样的劝导不是出于那召你们的。
verses.textEnNiv: That kind of persuasion does not come from the one who calls you.
verses.textEnEsv: This persuasion is not from him who calls you.
verses.textEnNkjv: This persuasion does not come from Him who calls you.
verses.textEnNlt: It certainly isn’t God, for he is the one who called you to freedom.
verses.textEnNasb: This persuasion did not come from Him who calls you.
verses.textEn: That kind of persuasion does not come from the one who calls you.

verses.textZh: 一点面酵能使全团面发起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 一点面酵能使全团面发起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 一点面酵能使全团都发起来。
verses.textEnNiv: "A little yeast works through the whole batch of dough."
verses.textEnEsv: A little leaven leavens the whole lump.
verses.textEnNkjv: A little leaven leavens the whole lump.
verses.textEnNlt: This false teaching is like a little yeast that spreads through the whole batch of dough!
verses.textEnNasb: A little leaven leavens the whole lump of dough.
verses.textEn: "A little yeast works through the whole batch of dough."

verses.textZh: 我在主里深信你们不会存别的意念；但那搅扰你们的，无论是谁，必定要受刑罚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在主里深信你们不会存别的意念；但那搅扰你们的，无论是谁，必定要受刑罚。
verses.textZhCuv: 我在主里很信你们必不怀别样的心；但搅扰你们的，无论是谁，必担当他的罪名。
verses.textEnNiv: I am confident in the Lord that you will take no other view. The one who is throwing you into confusion, whoever that may be, will have to pay the penalty.
verses.textEnEsv: I have confidence in the Lord that you will take no other view, and the one who is troubling you will bear the penalty, whoever he is.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have confidence in you, in the Lord, that you will have no other mind; but he who troubles you shall bear his judgment, whoever he is.
verses.textEnNlt: I am trusting the Lord to keep you from believing false teachings. God will judge that person, whoever he is, who has been confusing you.
verses.textEnNasb: I have confidence in you in the Lord, that you will adopt no other view; but the one who is disturbing you will bear the punishment, whoever he is.
verses.textEn: I am confident in the Lord that you will take no other view. The one who is throwing you into confusion, whoever that may be, will have to pay the penalty.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，如果我仍旧传割礼，我为甚么还受迫害呢？若是这样，十字架绊倒人的地方就没有了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，如果我仍旧传割礼，我为甚么还受迫害呢？若是这样，十字架绊倒人的地方就没有了。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，我若仍旧传割礼，为什么还受逼迫呢？若是这样，那十字架讨厌的地方就没有了。
verses.textEnNiv: Brothers and sisters, if I am still preaching circumcision, why am I still being persecuted? In that case the offense of the cross has been abolished.
verses.textEnEsv: But if I, brothers, still preach circumcision, why am I still being persecuted? In that case the offense of the cross has been removed.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I, brethren, if I still preach circumcision, why do I still suffer persecution? Then the offense of the cross has ceased.
verses.textEnNlt: Dear brothers and sisters, if I were still preaching that you must be circumcised—as some say I do—why am I still being persecuted? If I were no longer preaching salvation through the cross of Christ, no one would be offended.
verses.textEnNasb: But as for me, brothers and sisters, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the stumbling block of the cross has been eliminated.
verses.textEn: Brothers and sisters, if I am still preaching circumcision, why am I still being persecuted? In that case the offense of the cross has been abolished.

verses.textZh: 我恨不得那些扰乱你们的人把自己阉割了！
verses.textZhCnvs: 我恨不得那些扰乱你们的人把自己阉割了！
verses.textZhCuv: 恨不得那搅乱你们的人把自己割绝了。
verses.textEnNiv: As for those agitators, I wish they would go the whole way and emasculate themselves!
verses.textEnEsv: I wish those who unsettle you would emasculate themselves!
verses.textEnNkjv: I could wish that those who trouble you would even cut themselves off!
verses.textEnNlt: I just wish that those troublemakers who want to mutilate you by circumcision would mutilate themselves.
verses.textEnNasb: I wish that those who are troubling you would even emasculate themselves.
verses.textEn: As for those agitators, I wish they would go the whole way and emasculate themselves!

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，你们蒙召得了自由；只是不可把这自由当作放纵情欲的机会，总要凭着爱心互相服事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，你们蒙召得了自由；只是不可把这自由当作放纵情欲的机会，总要凭着爱心互相服事。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，你们蒙召是要得自由，只是不可将你们的自由当作放纵情欲的机会，总要用爱心互相服事。
verses.textEnNiv: You, my brothers and sisters, were called to be free. But do not use your freedom to indulge the flesh ; rather, serve one another humbly in love.
verses.textEnEsv: For you were called to freedom, brothers. Only do not use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love serve one another.
verses.textEnNkjv: For you, brethren, have been called to liberty; only do not use liberty as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love serve one another.
verses.textEnNlt: For you have been called to live in freedom, my brothers and sisters. But don’t use your freedom to satisfy your sinful nature. Instead, use your freedom to serve one another in love.
verses.textEnNasb: For you were called to freedom, brothers and sisters; only do not turn your freedom into an opportunity for the flesh, but serve one another through love.
verses.textEn: You, my brothers and sisters, were called to be free. But do not use your freedom to indulge the flesh ; rather, serve one another humbly in love.

verses.textZh: 因为全部的律法，都在"爱人如己"这一句话里面成全了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为全部的律法，都在"爱人如己"这一句话里面成全了。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为全律法都包在「爱人如己」这一句话之内了。
verses.textEnNiv: For the entire law is fulfilled in keeping this one command: "Love your neighbor as yourself."
verses.textEnEsv: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word: "You shall love your neighbor as yourself."
verses.textEnNkjv: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this: "You shall love your neighbor as yourself."
verses.textEnNlt: For the whole law can be summed up in this one command: "Love your neighbor as yourself."
verses.textEnNasb: For the whole Law is fulfilled in one word, in the statement, "You shall love your neighbor as yourself."
verses.textEn: For the entire law is fulfilled in keeping this one command: "Love your neighbor as yourself."

verses.textZh: 你们要谨慎，如果相咬相吞，恐怕彼此都要毁灭了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要谨慎，如果相咬相吞，恐怕彼此都要毁灭了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要谨慎，若相咬相吞，只怕要彼此消灭了。
verses.textEnNiv: If you bite and devour each other, watch out or you will be destroyed by each other.
verses.textEnEsv: But if you bite and devour one another, watch out that you are not consumed by one another.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if you bite and devour one another, beware lest you be consumed by one another!
verses.textEnNlt: But if you are always biting and devouring one another, watch out! Beware of destroying one another.
verses.textEnNasb: But if you bite and devour one another, take care that you are not consumed by one another.
verses.textEn: If you bite and devour each other, watch out or you will be destroyed by each other.

verses.textZh: 我是说，你们应当顺着圣灵行事，这样就一定不会去满足肉体的私欲了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我是说，你们应当顺着圣灵行事，这样就一定不会去满足肉体的私欲了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我说，你们当顺着圣灵而行，就不放纵肉体的情欲了。
verses.textEnNiv: So I say, walk by the Spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh.
verses.textEnEsv: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh.
verses.textEnNkjv: I say then: Walk in the Spirit, and you shall not fulfill the lust of the flesh.
verses.textEnNlt: So I say, let the Holy Spirit guide your lives. Then you won’t be doing what your sinful nature craves.
verses.textEnNasb: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you will not carry out the desire of the flesh.
verses.textEn: So I say, walk by the Spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh.

verses.textZh: 因为肉体的私欲和圣灵敌对，圣灵也和肉体敌对；这两样互相敌对，使你们不能作自己愿意作的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为肉体的私欲和圣灵敌对，圣灵也和肉体敌对；这两样互相敌对，使你们不能作自己愿意作的。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为情欲和圣灵相争，圣灵和情欲相争，这两个是彼此相敌，使你们不能做所愿意做的。
verses.textEnNiv: For the flesh desires what is contrary to the Spirit, and the Spirit what is contrary to the flesh. They are in conflict with each other, so that you are not to do whatever you want.
verses.textEnEsv: For the desires of the flesh are against the Spirit, and the desires of the Spirit are against the flesh, for these are opposed to each other, to keep you from doing the things you want to do.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, so that you do not do the things that you wish.
verses.textEnNlt: The sinful nature wants to do evil, which is just the opposite of what the Spirit wants. And the Spirit gives us desires that are the opposite of what the sinful nature desires. These two forces are constantly fighting each other, so you are not free to carry out your good intentions.
verses.textEnNasb: For the desire of the flesh is against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; for these are in opposition to one another, in order to keep you from doing whatever you want.
verses.textEn: For the flesh desires what is contrary to the Spirit, and the Spirit what is contrary to the flesh. They are in conflict with each other, so that you are not to do whatever you want.

verses.textZh: 但你们若被圣灵引导，就不在律法以下了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但你们若被圣灵引导，就不在律法以下了。
verses.textZhCuv: 但你们若被圣灵引导，就不在律法以下。
verses.textEnNiv: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.
verses.textEnEsv: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.
verses.textEnNlt: But when you are directed by the Spirit, you are not under obligation to the law of Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the Law.
verses.textEn: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.

verses.textZh: 肉体所行的都是显而易见的，就如淫乱、污秽、邪荡、
verses.textZhCnvs: 肉体所行的都是显而易见的，就如淫乱、污秽、邪荡、
verses.textZhCuv: 情欲的事都是显而易见的，就如奸淫、污秽、邪荡、
verses.textEnNiv: The acts of the flesh are obvious: sexual immorality, impurity and debauchery;
verses.textEnEsv: Now the works of the flesh are evident: sexual immorality, impurity, sensuality,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the works of the flesh are evident, which are: adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lewdness,
verses.textEnNlt: When you follow the desires of your sinful nature, the results are very clear: sexual immorality, impurity, lustful pleasures,
verses.textEnNasb: Now the deeds of the flesh are evident, which are: sexual immorality, impurity, indecent behavior,
verses.textEn: The acts of the flesh are obvious: sexual immorality, impurity and debauchery;

verses.textZh: 拜偶像、行邪术、仇恨、争竞、忌恨、忿怒、自私、分党、结派、
verses.textZhCnvs: 拜偶像、行邪术、仇恨、争竞、忌恨、忿怒、自私、分党、结派、
verses.textZhCuv: 拜偶像、邪术、仇恨、争竞、忌恨、恼怒、结党、纷争、异端、
verses.textEnNiv: idolatry and witchcraft; hatred, discord, jealousy, fits of rage, selfish ambition, dissensions, factions
verses.textEnEsv: idolatry, sorcery, enmity, strife, jealousy, fits of anger, rivalries, dissensions, divisions,
verses.textEnNkjv: idolatry, sorcery, hatred, contentions, jealousies, outbursts of wrath, selfish ambitions, dissensions, heresies,
verses.textEnNlt: idolatry, sorcery, hostility, quarreling, jealousy, outbursts of anger, selfish ambition, dissension, division,
verses.textEnNasb: idolatry, witchcraft, hostilities, strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, selfish ambition, dissensions, factions,
verses.textEn: idolatry and witchcraft; hatred, discord, jealousy, fits of rage, selfish ambition, dissensions, factions

verses.textZh: 嫉妒、醉酒、荒宴，和类似的事。我从前早就告诉过你们，现在又事先告诉你们：行这些事的人，必定不能承受神的国。
verses.textZhCnvs: 嫉妒、醉酒、荒宴，和类似的事。我从前早就告诉过你们，现在又事先告诉你们：行这些事的人，必定不能承受神的国。
verses.textZhCuv: 嫉妒 、醉酒、荒宴等类。我从前告诉你们，现在又告诉你们，行这样事的人必不能承受神的国。
verses.textEnNiv: and envy; drunkenness, orgies, and the like. I warn you, as I did before, that those who live like this will not inherit the kingdom of God.
verses.textEnEsv: envy, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these. I warn you, as I warned you before, that those who do such things will not inherit the kingdom of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: envy, murders, drunkenness, revelries, and the like; of which I tell you beforehand, just as I also told you in time past, that those who practice such things will not inherit the kingdom of God.
verses.textEnNlt: envy, drunkenness, wild parties, and other sins like these. Let me tell you again, as I have before, that anyone living that sort of life will not inherit the Kingdom of God.
verses.textEnNasb: envy, drunkenness, carousing, and things like these, of which I forewarn you, just as I have forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit the kingdom of God.
verses.textEn: and envy; drunkenness, orgies, and the like. I warn you, as I did before, that those who live like this will not inherit the kingdom of God.

verses.textZh: 但圣灵的果子是仁爱、喜乐、平安、忍耐、恩慈、良善、信实、
verses.textZhCnvs: 但圣灵的果子是仁爱、喜乐、平安、忍耐、恩慈、良善、信实、
verses.textZhCuv: 圣灵所结的果子，就是仁爱、喜乐、和平、忍耐、恩慈、良善、信实、
verses.textEnNiv: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, forbearance, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,
verses.textEnEsv: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,
verses.textEnNkjv: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,
verses.textEnNlt: But the Holy Spirit produces this kind of fruit in our lives: love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,
verses.textEnNasb: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,
verses.textEn: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, forbearance, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,

verses.textZh: 温柔、节制；这样的事，是没有律法禁止的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 温柔、节制；这样的事，是没有律法禁止的。
verses.textZhCuv: 温柔、节制。这样的事没有律法禁止。
verses.textEnNiv: gentleness and self-control. Against such things there is no law.
verses.textEnEsv: gentleness, self-control; against such things there is no law.
verses.textEnNkjv: gentleness, self-control. Against such there is no law.
verses.textEnNlt: gentleness, and self-control. There is no law against these things!
verses.textEnNasb: gentleness, self-control; against such things there is no law.
verses.textEn: gentleness and self-control. Against such things there is no law.

verses.textZh: 属基督耶稣的人，是已经把肉体和邪情私欲都钉在十字架上了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 属基督耶稣的人，是已经把肉体和邪情私欲都钉在十字架上了。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡属基督耶稣的人，是已经把肉体连肉体的邪情私欲同钉在十字架上了。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who belong to Christ Jesus have crucified the flesh with its passions and desires.
verses.textEnEsv: And those who belong to Christ Jesus have crucified the flesh with its passions and desires.
verses.textEnNkjv: And those whoare Christ’s have crucified the flesh with its passions and desires.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who belong to Christ Jesus have nailed the passions and desires of their sinful nature to his cross and crucified them there.
verses.textEnNasb: Now those who belong to Christ Jesus crucified the flesh with its passions and desires.
verses.textEn: Those who belong to Christ Jesus have crucified the flesh with its passions and desires.

verses.textZh: 如果我们靠圣灵活着，就应该顺着圣灵行事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果我们靠圣灵活着，就应该顺着圣灵行事。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们若是靠圣灵得生，就当靠圣灵行事。
verses.textEnNiv: Since we live by the Spirit, let us keep in step with the Spirit.
verses.textEnEsv: If we live by the Spirit, let us also keep in step with the Spirit.
verses.textEnNkjv: If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.
verses.textEnNlt: Since we are living by the Spirit, let us follow the Spirit’s leading in every part of our lives.
verses.textEnNasb: If we live by the Spirit, let’s follow the Spirit as well.
verses.textEn: Since we live by the Spirit, let us keep in step with the Spirit.

verses.textZh: 我们不可贪图虚荣，彼此触怒，互相嫉妒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们不可贪图虚荣，彼此触怒，互相嫉妒。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要贪图虚名，彼此惹气，互相嫉妒。
verses.textEnNiv: Let us not become conceited, provoking and envying each other.
verses.textEnEsv: Let us not become conceited, provoking one another, envying one another.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let us not become conceited, provoking one another, envying one another.
verses.textEnNlt: Let us not become conceited, or provoke one another, or be jealous of one another.
verses.textEnNasb: Let’s not become boastful, challenging one another, envying one another.
verses.textEn: Let us not become conceited, provoking and envying each other.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，如果有人陷在一些过犯里，你们属灵的人，要用温柔的心使他回转过来，自己却要小心，免得也被引诱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，如果有人陷在一些过犯里，你们属灵的人，要用温柔的心使他回转过来，自己却要小心，免得也被引诱。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，若有人偶然被过犯所胜，你们属灵的人就当用温柔的心把他挽回过来；又当自己小心，恐怕也被引诱。
verses.textEnNiv: Brothers and sisters, if someone is caught in a sin, you who live by the Spirit should restore that person gently. But watch yourselves, or you also may be tempted.
verses.textEnEsv: Brothers, if anyone is caught in any transgression, you who are spiritual should restore him in a spirit of gentleness. Keep watch on yourself, lest you too be tempted.
verses.textEnNkjv: Brethren, if a man is overtaken in any trespass, you who are spiritual restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness, considering yourself lest you also be tempted.
verses.textEnNlt: Dear brothers and sisters, if another believer is overcome by some sin, you who are godly should gently and humbly help that person back onto the right path. And be careful not to fall into the same temptation yourself.
verses.textEnNasb: Brothers and sisters, even if a person is caught in any wrongdoing, you who are spiritual are to restore such a person in a spirit of gentleness; each one looking to yourself, so that you are not tempted as well.
verses.textEn: Brothers and sisters, if someone is caught in a sin, you who live by the Spirit should restore that person gently. But watch yourselves, or you also may be tempted.

verses.textZh: 你们各人的重担要互相担当，这样就成全了基督的律法。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们各人的重担要互相担当，这样就成全了基督的律法。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们各人的重担要互相担当，如此，就完全了基督的律法。
verses.textEnNiv: Carry each other’s burdens, and in this way you will fulfill the law of Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: Share each other’s burdens, and in this way obey the law of Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: Bear one another’s burdens, and thereby fulfill the law of Christ.
verses.textEn: Carry each other’s burdens, and in this way you will fulfill the law of Christ.

verses.textZh: 如果有人本来没有甚么了不起，却自以为是了不起的，就是欺骗自己。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人本来没有甚么了不起，却自以为是了不起的，就是欺骗自己。
verses.textZhCuv: 人若无有，自己还以为有，就是自欺了。
verses.textEnNiv: If anyone thinks they are something when they are not, they deceive themselves.
verses.textEnEsv: For if anyone thinks he is something, when he is nothing, he deceives himself.
verses.textEnNkjv: For if anyone thinks himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceives himself.
verses.textEnNlt: If you think you are too important to help someone, you are only fooling yourself. You are not that important.
verses.textEnNasb: For if anyone thinks that he is something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.
verses.textEn: If anyone thinks they are something when they are not, they deceive themselves.

verses.textZh: 各人应该省察自己所作的，这样，他引以为荣的，就只在自己而不在别人了；
verses.textZhCnvs: 各人应该省察自己所作的，这样，他引以为荣的，就只在自己而不在别人了；
verses.textZhCuv: 各人应当察验自己的行为；这样，他所夸的就专在自己，不在别人了，
verses.textEnNiv: Each one should test their own actions. Then they can take pride in themselves alone, without comparing themselves to someone else,
verses.textEnEsv: But let each one test his own work, and then his reason to boast will be in himself alone and not in his neighbor.
verses.textEnNkjv: But let each one examine his own work, and then he will have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.
verses.textEnNlt: Pay careful attention to your own work, for then you will get the satisfaction of a job well done, and you won’t need to compare yourself to anyone else.
verses.textEnNasb: But each one must examine his own work, and then he will have reason for boasting, but to himself alone, and not to another.
verses.textEn: Each one should test their own actions. Then they can take pride in themselves alone, without comparing themselves to someone else,

verses.textZh: 因为各人的担子，是要自己担当的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为各人的担子，是要自己担当的。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为各人必担当自己的担子。
verses.textEnNiv: for each one should carry their own load.
verses.textEnEsv: For each will have to bear his own load.
verses.textEnNkjv: For each one shall bear his own load.
verses.textEnNlt: For we are each responsible for our own conduct.
verses.textEnNasb: For each one will bear his own load.
verses.textEn: for each one should carry their own load.

verses.textZh: 在圣道上受教的，应该和施教的人分享自己的一切美物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在圣道上受教的，应该和施教的人分享自己的一切美物。
verses.textZhCuv: 在道理上受教的，当把一切需用的供给施教的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Nevertheless, the one who receives instruction in the word should share all good things with their instructor.
verses.textEnEsv: Let the one who is taught the word share all good things with the one who teaches.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let him who is taught the word share in all good things with him who teaches.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who are taught the word of God should provide for their teachers, sharing all good things with them.
verses.textEnNasb: The one who is taught the word is to share all good things with the one who teaches him.
verses.textEn: Nevertheless, the one who receives instruction in the word should share all good things with their instructor.

verses.textZh: 不要自欺，神是不可轻慢的。人种的是甚么，收的也是甚么：
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要自欺，神是不可轻慢的。人种的是甚么，收的也是甚么：
verses.textZhCuv: 不要自欺，神是轻慢不得的。人种的是什么，收的也是什么。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not be deceived: God cannot be mocked. A man reaps what he sows.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not be deceived: God is not mocked, for whatever one sows, that will he also reap.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not be deceived, God is not mocked; for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t be misled—you cannot mock the justice of God. You will always harvest what you plant.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not be deceived, God is not mocked; for whatever a person sows, this he will also reap.
verses.textEn: Do not be deceived: God cannot be mocked. A man reaps what he sows.

verses.textZh: 顺着自己的肉体撒种的，必定从肉体收取败坏；顺着圣灵撒种的，必定从圣灵收取永生。
verses.textZhCnvs: 顺着自己的肉体撒种的，必定从肉体收取败坏；顺着圣灵撒种的，必定从圣灵收取永生。
verses.textZhCuv: 顺着情欲撒种的，必从情欲收败坏；顺着圣灵撒种的，必从圣灵收永生。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever sows to please their flesh, from the flesh will reap destruction; whoever sows to please the Spirit, from the Spirit will reap eternal life.
verses.textEnEsv: For the one who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption, but the one who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.
verses.textEnNkjv: For he who sows to his flesh will of the flesh reap corruption, but he who sows to the Spirit will of the Spirit reap everlasting life.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who live only to satisfy their own sinful nature will harvest decay and death from that sinful nature. But those who live to please the Spirit will harvest everlasting life from the Spirit.
verses.textEnNasb: For the one who sows to his own flesh will reap destruction from the flesh, but the one who sows to the Spirit will reap eternal life from the Spirit.
verses.textEn: Whoever sows to please their flesh, from the flesh will reap destruction; whoever sows to please the Spirit, from the Spirit will reap eternal life.

verses.textZh: 我们行善，不要觉得厌烦；如果不松懈，到了适当的时候，就有收成。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们行善，不要觉得厌烦；如果不松懈，到了适当的时候，就有收成。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们行善，不可丧志；若不灰心，到了时候就要收成。
verses.textEnNiv: Let us not become weary in doing good, for at the proper time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.
verses.textEnEsv: And let us not grow weary of doing good, for in due season we will reap, if we do not give up.
verses.textEnNkjv: And let us not grow weary while doing good, for in due season we shall reap if we do not lose heart.
verses.textEnNlt: So let’s not get tired of doing what is good. At just the right time we will reap a harvest of blessing if we don’t give up.
verses.textEnNasb: Let’s not become discouraged in doing good, for in due time we will reap, if we do not become weary.
verses.textEn: Let us not become weary in doing good, for at the proper time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.

verses.textZh: 所以，我们一有机会，就应该对众人行善，对信徒更要这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，我们一有机会，就应该对众人行善，对信徒更要这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，有了机会就当向众人行善，向信徒一家的人更当这样。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, as we have opportunity, let us do good to all people, especially to those who belong to the family of believers.
verses.textEnEsv: So then, as we have opportunity, let us do good to everyone, and especially to those who are of the household of faith.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, as we have opportunity, let us do good to all, especially to those who are of the household of faith.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, whenever we have the opportunity, we should do good to everyone—especially to those in the family of faith.
verses.textEnNasb: So then, while we have opportunity, let’s do good to all people, and especially to those who are of the household of the faith.
verses.textEn: Therefore, as we have opportunity, let us do good to all people, especially to those who belong to the family of believers.

verses.textZh: 请看，我亲手写给你们的字是多么的大。
verses.textZhCnvs: 请看，我亲手写给你们的字是多么的大。
verses.textZhCuv: 请看我亲手写给你们的字是何等的大呢！
verses.textEnNiv: See what large letters I use as I write to you with my own hand!
verses.textEnEsv: See with what large letters I am writing to you with my own hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: See with what large letters I have written to you with my own hand!
verses.textEnNlt: Notice what large letters I use as I write these closing words in my own handwriting.
verses.textEnNasb: See with what large letters I have written to you with my own hand!
verses.textEn: See what large letters I use as I write to you with my own hand!

verses.textZh: 那些在外表上要体面的人，他们勉强你们受割礼，不过是怕为了基督的十字架受迫害。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些在外表上要体面的人，他们勉强你们受割礼，不过是怕为了基督的十字架受迫害。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡希图外貌体面的人都勉强你们受割礼，无非是怕自己为基督的十字架受逼迫。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who want to impress people by means of the flesh are trying to compel you to be circumcised. The only reason they do this is to avoid being persecuted for the cross of Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: It is those who want to make a good showing in the flesh who would force you to be circumcised, and only in order that they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: As many as desire to make a good showing in the flesh, these would compel you to be circumcised, only that they may not suffer persecution for the cross of Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who are trying to force you to be circumcised want to look good to others. They don’t want to be persecuted for teaching that the cross of Christ alone can save.
verses.textEnNasb: All who want to make a good showing in the flesh try to compel you to be circumcised, simply so that they will not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.
verses.textEn: Those who want to impress people by means of the flesh are trying to compel you to be circumcised. The only reason they do this is to avoid being persecuted for the cross of Christ.

verses.textZh: 那些受割礼的人，自己也不遵守律法，反而要你们受割礼，为的是要借着你们的肉身夸口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些受割礼的人，自己也不遵守律法，反而要你们受割礼，为的是要借着你们的肉身夸口。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们那些受割礼的，连自己也不守律法；他们愿意你们受割礼，不过要藉着你们的肉体夸口。
verses.textEnNiv: Not even those who are circumcised keep the law, yet they want you to be circumcised that they may boast about your circumcision in the flesh.
verses.textEnEsv: For even those who are circumcised do not themselves keep the law, but they desire to have you circumcised that they may boast in your flesh.
verses.textEnNkjv: For not even those who are circumcised keep the law, but they desire to have you circumcised that they may boast in your flesh.
verses.textEnNlt: And even those who advocate circumcision don’t keep the whole law themselves. They only want you to be circumcised so they can boast about it and claim you as their disciples.
verses.textEnNasb: For those who are circumcised do not even keep the Law themselves, but they want to have you circumcised so that they may boast in your flesh.
verses.textEn: Not even those who are circumcised keep the law, yet they want you to be circumcised that they may boast about your circumcision in the flesh.

verses.textZh: 至于我，我绝不以别的夸口，只夸我们主耶稣基督的十字架。借着这十字架，在我来说，世界已经钉在十字架上了；就世界来说，我也已经钉在十字架上了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于我，我绝不以别的夸口，只夸我们主耶稣基督的十字架。借着这十字架，在我来说，世界已经钉在十字架上了；就世界来说，我也已经钉在十字架上了。
verses.textZhCuv: 但我断不以别的夸口，只夸我们主耶稣基督的十字架；因这十字架，就我而论，世界已经钉在十字架上；就世界而论，我已经钉在十字架上。
verses.textEnNiv: May I never boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.
verses.textEnEsv: But far be it from me to boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.
verses.textEnNkjv: But God forbid that I should boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.
verses.textEnNlt: As for me, may I never boast about anything except the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ. Because of that cross, my interest in this world has been crucified, and the world’s interest in me has also died.
verses.textEnNasb: But far be it from me to boast, except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.
verses.textEn: May I never boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.

verses.textZh: 受割礼或不受割礼，都算不得甚么，要紧的是作新造的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 受割礼或不受割礼，都算不得甚么，要紧的是作新造的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 受割礼不受割礼都无关紧要，要紧的就是作新造的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Neither circumcision nor uncircumcision means anything; what counts is the new creation.
verses.textEnEsv: For neither circumcision counts for anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.
verses.textEnNkjv: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision avails anything, but a new creation.
verses.textEnNlt: It doesn’t matter whether we have been circumcised or not. What counts is whether we have been transformed into a new creation.
verses.textEnNasb: For neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.
verses.textEn: Neither circumcision nor uncircumcision means anything; what counts is the new creation.

verses.textZh: 所有照这准则而行的人，愿平安怜悯临到他们，就是临到神的以色列。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有照这准则而行的人，愿平安怜悯临到他们，就是临到神的以色列。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡照此理而行的，愿平安、怜悯加给他们，和神的以色列民。
verses.textEnNiv: Peace and mercy to all who follow this rule—to the Israel of God.
verses.textEnEsv: And as for all who walk by this rule, peace and mercy be upon them, and upon the Israel of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: And as many as walk according to this rule, peace and mercy be upon them, and upon the Israel of God.
verses.textEnNlt: May God’s peace and mercy be upon all who live by this principle; they are the new people of God.
verses.textEnNasb: And all who will follow this rule, peace and mercy be upon them, and upon the Israel of God.
verses.textEn: Peace and mercy to all who follow this rule—to the Israel of God.

verses.textZh: 从今以后，谁也不要搅扰我，因为我身上带着耶稣的烙痕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从今以后，谁也不要搅扰我，因为我身上带着耶稣的烙痕。
verses.textZhCuv: 从今以后，人都不要搅扰我，因为我身上带着耶稣的印记。
verses.textEnNiv: From now on, let no one cause me trouble, for I bear on my body the marks of Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: From now on let no one cause me trouble, for I bear on my body the marks of Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: From now on let no one trouble me, for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus.
verses.textEnNlt: From now on, don’t let anyone trouble me with these things. For I bear on my body the scars that show I belong to Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: From now on let no one cause trouble for me, for I bear on my body the marks of Jesus.
verses.textEn: From now on, let no one cause me trouble, for I bear on my body the marks of Jesus.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，愿我们主耶稣基督的恩惠与你们同在 。阿们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，愿我们主耶稣基督的恩惠与你们同在 。阿们。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，愿我主耶稣基督的恩常在你们心里。阿们！
verses.textEnNiv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers and sisters. Amen.
verses.textEnEsv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.
verses.textEnNkjv: Brethren, the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
verses.textEnNlt: Dear brothers and sisters, may the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
verses.textEnNasb: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers and sisters. Amen.
verses.textEn: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers and sisters. Amen.
